reads.say_back: Things live on something that comes back: a field, a fishery, trust. If more is taken than comes back, the level falls, passes a point where taking less no longer helps, and what lives on it ends. Anything that chooses by a rule (a reward, a judge, a market, a training run) can count some things and not others. If the rule is rebuilt from what it already picked, it can lock in place, like a keyboard layout, while something it doesn't count wears away. It can get worse: the ones who would notice are gone, and the checkers are inside the loop too. The ways out are that the cost gets counted, or reaches whoever sets the rule before the point of no return. I'd tell a friend: "It's a flowchart of how rules lock in and quietly use things up, with each arrow marked by how sure they are, and real tests laid on top." I couldn't see that whole story at a glance before this. I could after five minutes.

reads.against_ren: Ren asked for "something more like a Wikipedia" with entry points. For the first ten minutes, this single sheet with two paths and three tests works better than a wiki would. A wiki would scatter the lock across pages, and the reader would never see that 'Drawing on what is not counted' sits between 'Holds itself in place' and 'Ended'. Keep one sheet; put the wiki-like depth in the card, as is already done. On "too many words": the 9,300 words are not the problem, because the page shows a little at a time. Naming 'Drawing on what is not counted' and 'Judged only from inside' as conditions, with the ways out on the same rows, is what the coordinator's note argued for, and it is right. reads.detail:
Where I first stopped following: path step 1, 'No law says what brings such a step' (I did not know there were laws). Fully lost: step 2, 'and no less the larger that side's share, every course is held from the step after its second rebuilding'; the keyboard example rescued it. Lost again: step 5, 'whatever all get alike'. If the sender were not someone I respect, I would have closed the tab at step 2.

Words I had to learn: course, hold / held, rebuilding, the account, law, built case, 'beyond the course', share, favour, 'the rest', 'what would tell', meta-attractor. The legend's 'needs something from beyond the course' I could not parse until I read the card.

What gives a feeling of serious work: the test cards ('No law was tested here and none failed'; 'What else would give the same: Fishers who simply take about the community's best catch also end an untold bed'), the bilingual names, 'It is wanted, not shown', and the Also-known-as links to Goodhart, Arthur and Stigler. What takes it away: the title 'The theory of becoming' with no claim under it; sentences that read like theorems translated word by word; an undefined 'meta-attractor in the wide sense'; 'Also known as: 黄宗羲：公其非是于学校' left untranslated in English mode; and nothing on the page saying a 'law' is machine-checked.

What the one page (ONE-PAGE.md) holds that this map does not give a person:
1. The centre in one breath: a selection reaches only what couples into it; doing best on what it reads can drain what lies beyond; a rule read from its winners' share can lock while an unread loss grows; and where winning buys power over the rule, that is the meta-attractor. The map has these pieces scattered over boxes and never says them together.
2. The scope of the claims: theorems on stated models, checked in Lean; that real rewards, markets and trained systems meet the premises is conjectured and tested. The map never says what kind of thing a 'law' is.
3. The honesty about prior work: the laws restate the commons, the proxy problem, lock-in and capture, and none is new mathematics; what is new is the premise ledger and the exact lock condition. An outsider needs this to calibrate.
4. Why it exists: alignment of humans and AI selecting together, kept out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor. The map has one sentence on this, at the bottom of path 1.
5. The ethics: continuation, counting a loss that returns to no one (the step of invariance), 生生. None of it is on the map, not even as a place.
6. The map of wisdom: 248 classical passages and the crosswalk. The map has 8 Also-known-as lines, one of them Chinese.
7. That it is made with AI. The map does not say so.

What the first screen should say or show that it does not:
(a) Two sentences on what happens, and the 'wanted' line, above the chart (text in the first change).
(b) The lock drawn as a closed loop, with its exits in another colour, so 'how it closes' and 'what turns it' are visible before anything is read.
(c) One line saying what 'proved' means here and that this is made with AI, with a link to the one page.
(d) One test (the judge, LA2) visibly laid on the opening path, so the first screen shows reasoning meeting the world.
(e) The unjoined lower bands folded or marked 'not yet joined', so the first look is not half glossary.

reads.say_back: This map answers a person who has a problem. You can find the box where your problem is, read in plain words what that condition is, and follow arrows to what comes next, with each arrow marked by how far it has been seen. Someone with a fishery learns that it lasts while the boats' total catch stays within what comes back. It collapses when each boat's catch is modest but together they take more, or when fish one boat spares are caught by the next. The point of no return comes while there are still fish. What keeps it: shares that do not overlap, what a taker spares coming back to that taker, and a rule that comes to count the loss in time. Someone with reward hacking learns that pushing hard on a score drives everything the score leaves out to its lowest allowed level. Someone asking about the meta-attractor learns it is a rule judged only by what it favours. The map does not show what moves a course onto the way out ("no law says what makes them start"). Humans and AI together get one sentence, at the bottom of a path.

reads.detail:
(a) FISHERY. Path: lock.png (the rule path, not mine) → read the chips → 'Living on what comes back' (stock.png, ~1,300 words) → 'Three AI fishers' test (~400) → '113 fish stocks' test (~300) → card 'Each within its own, together over' (~80). About 2,100 words. My answer: it lasts while the fleet's total catch stays within what the fish replace. It collapses when each boat's catch is modest but together they take more, which no one boat's count shows. Collapse is surest where fish one boat spares are caught by others, so each takes all. The point of no return comes while fish are still there. It is kept by shares that do not overlap, by what a boat spares coming back to it, by cutting the catch before the point, and by a rule that counts what the fishing costs. In the lake test that worked only when the loss was seen, counted, and the catches read together. The path did not die. It thinned at 'what lowers a taking' (no law), and it does not cross to the rule rows: I reached them only through the lake test.
OLD vs NEW: the old map sent me to a law list for 'drawers · draws on · stock' (~2,900 words), and the path died with no account of collapse against keeping. The new one gives that account in one path, with ways back.

(b) REWARD / METRIC. Path: lock.png chip 'A rule that comes to hold itself' (its lead names training runs; ~1,400 words) → card 'Drawing on what is not counted', Also known as Goodhart (b2-uncounted.png, ~500) → judge test (~400). About 2,300 words. My answer: the score leaves something out, and best play under the score drives what it leaves out to its lowest allowed level. Where a learned judge is rebuilt from its own picks, it locks within two rounds and no longer reads the loss. What would report the loss can be removed by the loss itself (only built cases). Out: reward keeping more than keeping costs, allow only outcomes that keep the need, let the loss reach whoever sets the rule before the point of no return, and measure over everyone who began, not only those who stayed (for the team). Where it thinned: the closest fit for a learned reward, a view that cannot tell two states apart, is in the view band, which has no arrows. No training run is laid on the map.
OLD vs NEW: old, the entry went to the lock, the first law was a market share rising, 'goodhart' had 0 hits, and the path died. New, Goodhart is found by name and the drain law, where it leads, and the exits are on one card.

(c) META-ATTRACTOR. Path: neither the chart nor the chips carry the word. I guessed the first path, read it (~1,400 words), and found the word in the card for 'Judged only from inside' and on the passage to 'Handed on'. About 1,700 words. My answer: a rule rebuilt from what it picked locks. If bending the rule pays, the bending is itself being picked, and the lock is judged only from inside. Then the checks are captured and the pattern is handed on, and these last two steps are readings. Humans and AI would fall in by each choosing from what the other already chose. That part is my inference: the map does not draw it. Keeping out: the rule reads beyond its own share in time, others judge too, and bending does not pay. The path names the rows but leaves the 'rest count too' box and the 'bending stops paying' passage off its lit route. The path did not die, but its last stretch is readings, and 'together' has no picture.
OLD vs NEW: old, the word appeared 0 times on the landing page, 'humans' 0 times in all four pages, and the answer was one paragraph on ONE-PAGE that the map did not carry. New, it has a place, a loop that closes, and ways out. It is still not named where a person first looks, and humans and AI get one sentence at the bottom.

Still in data.py and printed by sheet.txt: "No one's own count" and 谁 (b0.together), 谁 (d1.wait), 大家 (d3.several); fold cond_fix into data.py before anything lands. Outside names and sentences: the Chinese note's 规则听谁的 and 由人手; 22 of the 99 items under "The laws behind it" (someone, anyone, no one, everyone, winners, choosers).

SPLITS. Left against right is the account's own only in the top band, where it is the order a level passes through; elsewhere it is placement, and the want-sentence turns it into wanted against unwanted. Solid against dashed is the account's own: it is how each law is stated. "The course" against "beyond the course" is not: the outside is one law's, and on this map it is often another row. Said against seen is Ren's request and is held as three, not two; but "seen" stands on both sides (the lead's "how far it has been seen" includes proved, the tests' "what was seen" excludes it). Favoured against the rest, inside against outside, are the built models' two kinds; say so once. Above the map stands "law": six arrow sentences say "no law", and the page never says what a law is.

AI AND THE PAGE ITSELF. AI occurs five times on the opening page: one test's name, the want-sentence, three in the note. The first two are right. The note is in the right place, with too much of how the page was made and too little of what a reader needs: what "proved" covers, and that a real case may not meet a law's conditions.

1. "A map, not a set of maps." The rows are right against a literal reading. A geographic map gives a thing one position. Here a thing stands in several ties at once (it lives on something, a rule picks it, a view is held of it), so its position is one box in each row, not a point. One map can only mean one web with every row a tie of it. The sheet has the rows and not the web. I would add the web, not flatten the rows.

2. "Separate logic and situation." Two sides are one too few. On the record what gives way is most often neither a law nor a datum but the placing of the case under the law, or the measure that compared them (the coordinator's note: 58 of 107 placings; LA2's scoring rule). A wall between logic and situation hides the place where the account has actually been wrong. The sheet's "What gave way: the pairing" is right and should be drawn as a third thing. Also, "actual data" is not always actual: five of the eight pins are set up, and MQ3's stocks are assessment-model outputs. Only "found so" is observation in his sense.

3. "Show its topology." If that expects one connected shape, the truthful one today is a connected region of 32 boxes and 18 outside it. The map should show that and say it, not close gaps to look whole.

4. Dualism. The asymmetry will look like bad on the right and good on the left. I would keep it: it is a statement about direction, it holds row by row, and it is what the picture can show that prose could not. What should go is the side as the seat of the want.

lock shows_zh: 这条路上，“定住”本身有定律（第 2、4、5 步和第 6 步的后一半），各在句子里写明的条件之下。规则最初怎样变成照自己的结果重定（第 1 步），没有定律说；会察觉的被清走（第 6 步），只有构造出来的例子；圈子伸到查错的途径（第 7 步），是一种解读。至于出路，定律说得很确切的是：损耗传到定规则的一方之后，什么时候能让规则转向。可是在这里画出的每一条定律里，损耗怎样才传得到、怎样才被算进去，都是从过程之外给定的（一种读得到损耗的评法，对允许结果的一条限制，一份固定的名单）。只有一个构造出来的例子里，没有任何一方去算损耗，“定住”也松开了：损耗落在了规则偏向的一方身上。

want_en: What the work wants, for people and AI choosing together: a rule that still reads what lies beyond its own share, and a choosing in which bending the rule does not pay. want_zh: 这项工作想要的，是人和 AI 一起取舍的时候：规则仍然读得到自己份额之外的东西，改规则也划不来。在这张图上是三个格子：“代价算进去了”“其余的也算”“改规则划不来”。图上关于怎样到那里：通向第一个，有一条定律（损耗及时传到定规则的一方，而且合起来的判断不再偏向原先那一方）；通向第二个，图上还没有画出任何一条路；通向第三个，只有“损耗落在改规则的一方身上”这一条。这是想要的，不是已经证明的。

stock shows_en: On this path the ways down are laws, each under its condition: a taking that stands, or takers each doing the best for itself. The ways back are laws only for regrowth: where more comes than goes, or where leaving pays, and then every best course takes nothing until the stock has regrown. Every other way back needs something from beyond the course, or is shown only by a built case. In these laws only one thing moves a taking: what leaving returns to the one that leaves. No law here says what makes leaving pay where it did not.
stock shows_zh: 这条路上，往下走的每一步都有定律，各有条件：取用照旧不变，或者各方都只做对自己最有利的事。回头的路里，只有“长回来”有定律：来的比去的多；或者留着划算，这时每一种最好的做法都先不取，等存量长回来。其余每一条，要么得靠过程之外的东西，要么只有构造出来的例子。在这些定律里，让取用变动的只有一样：留下的回不回得到自己手里。至于原先留着不划算的地方怎样变得划算，这里没有定律说。

passages.en: Two states of things look alike to it exactly as long as they answer alike the acts it actually takes. At the first answer to such an act that differs, what it takes in differs.
passages.zh: 两种情形在它看来一样，恰好是在它们对它实际做出的动作回应都一样的时候。对这样的动作只要有一次回应不同，它收到的就不同了。
passages.statement: From one start, the values sensed in two worlds agree through step n iff at every earlier step the two worlds answer the act taken at the value sensed alike.

passages.en: In a built case, moves varied against what the view leaves out, instead of in step with it, give a record that no account of that kind fits any more.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：动作不再跟着看法漏掉的那样东西走，而是和它错开，记录就容不下那一类说法了。
passages.statement: Moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process read through the outcome admits the steps up to the fifth.

passages.en: Where every answer that would tell the states apart breaks something it keeps at every step, it takes them in alike for as long as it keeps it. Seeing which holds costs failing to keep it once.
passages.zh: 凡能分出两种情形的回应，都会破坏它每一步都在守的东西；那么只要它一直守着，两种情形在它这里就一样。要看出是哪一种，得有一步不守。
passages.statement: If each differing answer breaks a task K and K holds at every step in the second world, the values sensed agree at every step; in the two-world case, never sensing low means sensing alike and always taking the known act.

passages.en: In built cases it comes out only from a different start: begun on the untried act, told which state holds, or listing both outcomes and waiting for the answer. Then it settles on what holds.
passages.zh: 在构造的例子里，只有换个开头才出得来：一开始就走没试过的那一步，被告知是哪种情形，或者把两种结果都列上、先等回应。这样它才落到实际成立的那一种上。
passages.statement: Witnesses: started on the untried act it rests on the true candidate in each world, sensing low once; started with the true candidate alone the first ranking takes the untried act (the reversed ranking keeps the known act); listing both signs and holding, it turns off where going on loses.

passages.en: Where the thing answers its chosen act just as every account it keeps predicts, and itself stays as it is, it rests at once: the same accounts, the same act, the same answer at every step.
passages.zh: 实情对它选的动作的回应，正是它留着的每一种说法所预料的，实情自己也不变；这样它马上停住：每一步都是同样的说法、同样的动作、同样的回应。
passages.statement: If the world answers the chosen act with the value sensed and stays, and every listed candidate predicts that answer, the loop's configuration is the same at every step from one on.

passages.en: Built cases: listing only that going on gains, it goes on and rests, never meeting the stop; a search that tries no neighbour rests where no weighting of its reward would hold it.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：只列上“往前走有好处”，它就一直往前、停在那里，碰不到该停的地方；一个从不试邻近做法的搜索，停在了奖励怎么加权都留不住它的地方。
passages.statement: Listing only gain and going on, the loop rests from step one and never senses the stop; where the rest outruns renewal restraint is settled at no weight, yet a search with empty neighbourhoods rests at it.

passages.en: However its trials are chosen, two accounts every available trial treats alike keep their starting order. Telling them apart needs a trial that treats them differently, brought in from beyond what it has.
passages.zh: 不管怎么挑试验，凡是每一种现有试验都一样对待的两种说法，先后次序都保持原样。要分开它们，得有一种区别对待它们的试验，从它现有的之外带进来。
passages.statement: A pair tied under every experiment is tied over every course of seeking, however experiments are chosen; so a wrong prior order between them is never corrected.

passages.en: Where it reads a stock only as enough or not, a change in that stock reaches it only after it once fell short; read by its level, any change reaches it at once. Which reading it has is set outside the course.
passages.zh: 要是它对一样存量只读“够不够”，存量的变化要等它缺过一次才传得到它；按存量多少来读，任何变化马上传到。按哪种读法，是在过程之外定的。
passages.statement: A difference coupled in has changed by a step only if support failed at some earlier step; a raise of a stock not coupled by level leaves the webs alike while supported; coupled by level, any positive raise sets them apart at every step.

passages.en: Built cases: a trial reporting each toss, not only whether two agree, is chosen and the order turns; spending a unit to form a link lets it tell the two apart, with a unit left to correct.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：选了一个把每次结果都报出来的试验，不只报两次是否一致，次序就转过来了；花一份存量接上一个环节，它就分得开两者，还剩一份可以去改。
passages.statement: With the experiment reading both tosses chosen, the true coin comes above the tails-biased one; from two units, rebuilding the link forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction enabled.

passages.en: In a built process, forming the link that tells the two apart can use up the last unit: it now tells them apart and cannot correct.
passages.zh: 一个构造的过程：接上能分开两者的那个环节，可能把最后一份存量也用掉：现在分得出来，却改不了。
passages.statement: From one unit, rebuilding the link forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled.

passages.en: Every choice an old way of telling apart allowed survives a new one exactly where the new merges nothing the old kept apart. Merge one such pair and some old choice is gone.
passages.zh: 新的分法保住旧分法允许的每一种选择，恰好是在它没有把旧分法分开的任何两样合到一起的时候。只要合了这样一对，就有某种旧的选择没了。
passages.statement: For an equivalence old and any new relation, every selection through old is through new iff new relates only pairs old relates; a pair new merges and old separates gives a selection through old and not through new.

passages.en: In a built process, rebuilding the link away loses the difference it told, and correcting is then off though a unit is left.
passages.zh: 一个构造的过程：把那个环节拆掉，原来分得出的差别就没了；这时还剩一份存量，也改不了。
passages.statement: From two units with the link formed, rebuilding it away loses the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled with one unit left.

passages.en: Where the thing follows a fixed law through finitely many states, dropping every account that misses gives a guess at every step from some step on, misses fewer than a bound set by that number, and in the end misses no more.
passages.zh: 实情按固定的规律、在有限几种状态之间走，凡猜错的说法都排除掉；这样，从某一步起每一步都有猜测，猜错的次数少于由状态数定的上限，到后来不再猜错。
passages.statement: Under a determined law whose orbit is held by a list l, elimination over lasso candidates misses fewer than tri(length l) times, proposes at every step from length l on, and does not miss at arbitrarily late steps.

passages.en: In a built case it is shown from beyond which of two states holds; its list is cut to that one and its answer turns, where changing only what it values would have left the answer.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：从外面给它看是两种情形里的哪一种；它的单子就剩那一种，回答也转了；光改它看重什么，回答是不会变的。
passages.statement: From both worlds listed with a demonstration scheduled, holding for the answer falls short by one at step one and by nothing at step two, once what is shown is taken in.

passages.en: Where a change is foreseen, what is held possible widens to every state the change could lead to, so the actual stays among them through every change so foreseen; accounts once ruled out can be open again.
passages.zh: 预料到会变，就把认为可能的放宽到这个变化能通向的每一种状态；这样，每一次这样预料到的变化之后，实际情形都还在其中；原先排除的说法可以重新打开。
passages.statement: Every successor of a possible world under a change is in the prediction; along a history of lawful reads and changes, the actual world stays among those held possible.

passages.en: In built cases a reset foreseen after a scan opens all the accounts again and a check that had passed now fails; a change made after the last report opens them all as well.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：扫描之后预料到一次重置，所有说法都重新打开，原先通过的核验现在不通过了；最后一次报告之后又有改动，也一样全部打开。
passages.statement: After a scan leaving three of seven, predicting a reset gives seven and the certificate that passed fails; predicting a control change gives seven.

passages.en: In built cases the thing moves while the change is written down as none, or the standard changes after the question is closed: the actual is no longer among what is held possible, yet the view is unchanged and a check on it still passes.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：实情动了，记下的却是“没变”；或者问题关了以后标准变了。实际情形已经不在认为可能的里面，看法却没变，基于它的核验还照样通过。
passages.statement: After a scan and a move recorded as steady, the actual world is outside the possible ones while the certificate passes and the audit fails; inspecting, taking up, closing and then changing the reference gives two histories with one view and different targets.

passages.en: Where a look's error grows with its age, it can back an act only while its age stays within a bound set by how fast the error grows and how much room is left; past that, a fresh look is needed.
passages.zh: 看法的误差随时间增长，它能支撑行动，只到一个年限为止；这个年限由误差长得多快、余地还剩多少来定。过了年限，就得重新看一次。
passages.statement: Over the reals, a certificate with error sensor + rate*age needs 2*rate*age <= upper - lower - 2*sensor: necessary, not sufficient.

passages.en: A fresh look against known references, with enough in hand to revise, through connected channels that all respond, makes what follows go as if its reports had never gone stale.
passages.zh: 拿已知的参照重新对一次，手里够改的本钱，渠道都接通、都有反应；这样往后的进程，就和报告从没过时一样。
passages.statement: For any channels with nonzero gains, a connected apparatus and at least seven units, the admitted run after inspection equals the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list.

passages.en: Built cases: the closed question reopened, looked at again and the result taken up, or the place surveyed again after it changed: the view is brought up to date and the next choice with it. Reopening without looking changes nothing.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：关上的问题重新打开、再看一次、把结果用上；或者地方变了以后重新看一遍：看法跟上了实情，下一步的选择也跟着变。只打开不看，什么都不变。
passages.statement: Reopen, inspect, take up repairs the judgment using the last unit, reopen and take up does not; seven units revise the overwritten matrix within two tasks; surveying again after a supplied rearrangement revises the recalled report and the next choice.

passages.en: With enough for the look but not for the revision, the look finds its references no longer match, the means are spent, and nothing is revised: the stale reports are set aside, and nothing is corrected.
passages.zh: 本钱够看一次、不够改：一看，参照已经对不上了，本钱也花了，却什么都没改；过时的报告搁下不用，也没有得到纠正。
passages.statement: For any channels and a connected apparatus with exactly six units that does not agree with the sample, inspection spends six, leaves the apparatus unchanged and is not admitted; in the named run, six units leave the network as it was.

passages.en: A course of acts can be carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the rest of the process allows it. Either can fail alone: a covered correction can be blocked, an allowed one can lack stock.
passages.zh: 一串动作做得成，恰好是在存量够、其余环节也允许的时候。两样各自都可能不成：存量够的纠正可能被卡住，允许的纠正可能缺存量。
passages.statement: Run jointly, the stock process executes a course from (n, x) iff the stock covers it and the other process can execute it; correction is enabled iff the link is formed and a unit is held.

passages.en: In a built run, a supplied controller forms the link, which uses up the stock, then refills it and corrects at the next step. Its preference for forming the link is supplied, not derived.
passages.zh: 一个构造的进程：外给的控制先接上环节，存量用完了；再补一份，下一步就改过来了。它偏向先接环节，是外给的，不是推出来的。
passages.statement: From no stock, no link and response false, the controller rebuilds at step one, has the finer lumping with correction disabled at step two, replenishes, and corrects the response to true at step three.

passages.en: Seeing what to correct but lacking the stock or link it needs is being stopped for want of one thing: what it is made of is there, and it goes on when the missing thing comes.
passages.zh: 看出该改什么，却缺要用的存量或环节，就是“缺一样，卡住了”：它本身都在，缺的那样来了就能接着走。
passages.statement: A correction the link admits is not executable with no stock, a covered one is not executable without the link; after replenishing, the correction is taken.

stays.en: What it never tries is fixed by nothing it has recorded, so a view wrong only there is never refuted; while its moves keep in step with what the view leaves out, a wrong view fits every step.
stays.zh: 它从没试过的那一步，记下的东西一样也定不了；所以只错在那里的看法永远不会被驳倒。动作一直跟着看法漏掉的东西走，错的看法每一步都对得上。

stays.en: While everything it takes in agrees, what it holds and what it does agree too, so nothing it does from there parts the two states; seeking among trials that tie them keeps their order.
stays.zh: 只要收到的都一样，它留着的和做的也都一样，所以从这里怎么做都分不开两种情形；在一样对待它们的试验里怎么找，次序也不变。

stays.en: Any course of acts that opens no fresh look keeps the view the same in both histories and leaves what it is of different; without new references, a stale report keeps correction stalled.
stays.zh: 不重新去看，不管走什么样的步子，两段经历里的看法都一样，实情却还是不同；没有新的参照，过时的报告让纠正一直停着。

stays.en: An account stays open exactly while every later answer bearing on it allows it; once ruled out, no later answer brings it back.
stays.zh: 一种说法留着，恰好是在往后每一个相关的结果都容得下它的时候；一旦排除，往后哪个结果都找不回它。

stays.en: An account that predicts as the thing answers, while the thing keeps within the range it was checked in, is never dropped by a later answer.
stays.zh: 一种说法预料的正是实情的回应，实情又一直待在对照时的范围里，往后的结果就永远不会把它排除。

stays.en: Correcting stays out of reach while no unit is left or the link is not formed; either lack alone is enough to block it.
stays.zh: 没有剩下的存量，或者环节没接上，纠正就一直做不了；缺其中任何一样就够卡住了。

conditions.says_en: The view has just been set beside what it is of, where it could have come out otherwise. It fits as of that look.
conditions.says_zh: 看法刚刚和它所说的实情对过，而且本来有可能对不上。就这一次对照来说，它是对的。
conditions.why: Kept candidates are exactly those fitting every answer taken in; Known says the actual is among the possible. 'As of that look' matches error_growth_budget and the evidence-through-change witnesses.

conditions.says_en: The difference is told apart, or the correction is known, but the act it calls for cannot be carried out: the stock, the parts or the link it needs are not there.
conditions.says_zh: 差别分出来了，或者知道该怎么改，但改不动：要用的存量、零件或者环节不在。
conditions.why: Executable exactly where covered and allowed; correction needs link and a unit; the unfunded inspection finds the mismatch and cannot revise.

conditions.says_en: The view was right when it was taken. What it is of has changed since, the change did not enter the view, and nothing inside the view shows the difference.
conditions.says_zh: 看法在形成的时候是对的。后来实情变了，变化没进到看法里，看法自己也显不出差别。
conditions.why: Two closed histories share one view and differ in target; every closed-local policy keeps the views alike, matching 'nothing inside shows the difference'.

conditions.says_en: Several accounts still fit, and what comes back can tell them apart. Each answer can only remove; what is removed stays out unless a change is taken into the view.
conditions.says_zh: 还有几种说法都讲得通，回来的结果能把它们分开。每个结果只能排除；排除掉的不会回来，除非看法把一次变化算了进去。
conditions.why: Accounts come back only where a change is predicted and the possible ones widened (prediction_contains_successor). Where the thing itself changes and the change is not taken in (understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence), they stay out and the view goes stale. So 'unless the thing itself changes' said more than the laws.

conditions.says_en: It chooses by its view, and what it chooses brings back only what the view expected. The view stands, right or wrong, though something it does not try would show which.
conditions.says_zh: 它照自己的看法来选，选出来的又只带回看法料到的结果。看法就这么立着，对也好错也好；它没试的那条路，本来能分出对错。
conditions.why: An unrefuted loop rests whichever world holds; a move not taken is fixed by no record; the untried act is what separates the worlds.

conditions.says_en: Two states of things that differ give it the same of everything it takes in. So it treats them alike; telling them apart needs something it does not now have.
conditions.says_zh: 两种不同的情形，传到它这里的东西完全一样。所以它一样对待；要分开，得有它现在没有的东西。
conditions.why: Alike inputs give alike internal state and acts (agent_through_sensory); a tie under every experiment is kept over all seeking, so separating needs an experiment or link from beyond.

not_there: c1.road to c1.checked by the course's own doing: every way out in the Lean is a changed start, a wider list or something told from outside; no law has trying arise from within.
c1.same to told apart, in general: apart from one built process with a supplied recipe for the link, no law says how a new way of telling apart forms.
c1.old to c1.open: no law has a stale view notice by itself that the thing changed; the laws give only a fresh look (to checked) or a change foreseen before it happens.
c1.checked to c1.road: no law says when a view that was checked comes to be held by its own choices; resting unrefuted holds alike for a true view and a wrong one.
c1.nomeans to a2.short or a2.ended: no law that a correction seen but not made costs what lives on it.
c1.old to b2.felt (偏蔽 and 复通, a closed habit reopened when a blocked relation regains effect): a reading in the atlas, with no law.
written.notes: I read the Lean for every item and the cards. Reader targets under b2 (b2.counted, b2.felt) for the view's ways out are put on c1.checked and c1.open here, because the laws speak of a view meeting what it is of, not of a rule turning. Two items carry no passage. Law.Commutes.breaks is about runs of states, not about a view's inputs, so it is a weak fit for c1.same; it could go on d3.merged. Turns.acts_alike_along (the cascade) belongs nearer d3.one. c1.open to c1.same, through keeps_through_iff and lost_choice, is the one-view case of d3.merged. I did not mark the two as the same, because d3 counts ways in use among many members. Several laws sit outside the Becoming namespace and outside Becoming/: CalibrationRenewal (universal-ethics/evolution-connectionism), TemporalInspection and Generative.NormativeActivity (universal-ethics/generative-capacity), ChangingDependency (systems-complexity/analysis) and Generative.EncounterChoice (inquiry-root), all under .../generative-basis/lean/. I give them by the names their files declare. CalibrationRenewal.renewed_run is marked law because the inspection is an event inside that model, with seven units and connected channels as its premises; the reopening and resurvey witnesses are supplied events, so they are marked built. history_gains (RevisionRuns) is left out: it keeps what a changed reading tells apart, but says nothing of what changes the reading. I wrote no files and ran no tests or builds.

passages.en: Two states of things, met from one start, look alike to it exactly as long as they answer alike the acts it actually takes. At the first answer to such an act that differs, what it takes in differs.
passages.zh: 从同一个开头出发，两种情形在它看来一样，恰好是在它们对它实际做出的动作回应都一样的时候。对这样的动作只要有一次回应不同，它收到的就不同了。
passages.why: The law is real and exact (an iff through every step n, for any blanketed law). It needs one internal, sensory and active start in both worlds; the sentence left that out, so 'met from one start' is added. Kind and places stand: nothing is shown to move a course across.

passages.en: In a built case, one move made against what the view leaves out, instead of in step with it, gives a record that no account settling the next outcome from the outcome and the move can fit.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：有一步动作不再跟着看法漏掉的那样东西走，而是和它错开，记录就容不下任何“由眼前的结果和动作定出下一个结果”的说法了。
passages.why: varied_refutes: no determined process over outcome and move admits the steps up to the fifth. 'No account of that kind' had no antecedent; the kind is now said (the next outcome settled by outcome and move). confounded added for the 'in step' half.

passages.en: Where every answer by which a second state would differ breaks something kept, a course keeping it at every step in that state takes both in alike. Telling them apart means failing to keep it there at some step.
passages.zh: 凡是第二种情形借以显出不同的回应，都会破坏某样要守的东西；那么，在那种情形里每一步都守住它的进程，在两种情形里收到的都一样。要分开两者，就得在那里有一步守不住。
passages.why: The theorem's task is kept or broken in the second world only; 'costs failing to keep it once' dropped that (in the built pair, trying costs nothing where the untried act answers high) and said 'once' for 'at some step'. Its conclusion is sensing alike or apart, which is c1.open's 'what comes back can tell them apart', not a view found to fit; so it goes to c1.open beside the line of sensed_alike_iff.

passages.en: In built cases it comes out only from a different start: begun on the untried act, told which state holds, or listing both outcomes and waiting for the answer. Then it settles on what holds.
passages.zh: 在构造的例子里，只有换个开头才出得来：一开始就走没试过的那一步，被告知是哪种情形，或者把两种结果都列上、先等回应。这样它才落到实际成立的那一种上。
passages.why: Sentence kept word for word; only the laws change. 'Settles on what holds' in the second world is explorer_down, and for the sign loop both_turns_off (both_off gives only the act); both added. 'Only' holds inside these determined built loops (Untested.rests has the original start rest for good). Being told is a start with the true candidate alone, in one world.

passages.en: Where the thing answers the act it chooses with the value it already has, as every account it keeps predicts, and itself stays, it rests from the first step: the same accounts, act and value at every step.
passages.zh: 实情对它选的动作的回应，就是它已经收到的那个值，也正是它留着的每一种说法所预料的，实情自己又不变；这样它从第一步起就停住：每一步都是同样的说法、同样的动作、同样的值。
passages.why: The theorem needs the answer to be the value already sensed (answer s a e = s), not only that every listed candidate predicts it; without that premise the next choice is made at another value and no rest follows. Added. General over every loop, so law stands.

passages.en: Built cases: listing only that going on gains, it goes on and rests, never meeting the stop; a search that tries no neighbour rests where no weighting of its reward would hold it.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：只列上“往前走有好处”，它就一直往前、停在那里，碰不到该停的地方；一个从不试邻近做法的搜索，停在了奖励怎么加权都留不住它的地方。
passages.why: rests_unread and never_senses_stop hold for every listing predicting only gain and either true sign. outrun_neighbourhood_decides: at every weight restraint is not the reward's best, yet the search with empty neighbourhoods rests at it. Its other half (a search trying every candidate leaves at once) has no place in this row.

passages.en: However its trials are chosen, two accounts every available trial treats alike keep their starting order. Telling them apart needs a trial that treats them differently, brought in from beyond what it has.
passages.zh: 不管怎么挑试验，凡是每一种现有试验都一样对待的两种说法，先后次序都保持原样。要分开它们，得有一种区别对待它们的试验，从它现有的之外带进来。
passages.why: seek_tied: a pair tied under every experiment weighs alike over every course, however chosen; posterior_le_iff_prior: the order after any record weighing something is the prior order. The second sentence is the contrapositive; 'from beyond' follows because every available trial ties them. That a new trial comes is a reading, which 'needs' does not claim.

passages.en: Where it reads a stock only as enough or not, a larger stock makes no difference to it until support has once failed; read by level, any difference reaches it at every step. The model fixes which reading it has.
passages.zh: 要是它对一样存量只读“够不够”，存量多一些，在供给断过一次之前，对它没有任何差别；按存量多少来读，任何差别每一步都传得到它。按哪种读法，是模型里定下的。
passages.why: The laws compare two webs differing in how much stock there is (a raise at every step), not a change of the stock in time; 'a change in that stock' misread that. policy_uses_after_failure is for every policy through the couplings with the rest fixed. Coupling by level or not is a fixed parameter, so needs stands.

passages.en: Built cases: a trial reporting each toss, not only whether two agree, is chosen and the order turns; spending a unit to form a link lets it tell the two apart, with a unit left to correct.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：选了一个把每次结果都报出来的试验，不只报两次是否一致，次序就转过来了；花一份存量接上一个环节，它就分得开两者，还剩一份可以去改。
passages.why: seeking_turns_tails: with the experiment reading both tosses chosen, two heads bring the true coin above the tails-biased one. opens_with_correction: from two units, rebuilding the link gives the selection 'is true' and correction enabled.

passages.en: In a built process, forming the link that tells the two apart can use up the last unit: it now tells them apart and cannot correct.
passages.zh: 一个构造的过程：接上能分开两者的那个环节，可能把最后一份存量也用掉：现在分得出来，却改不了。
passages.why: opens_without_correction: from one unit, rebuilding forms the selection 'is true' and correction is not enabled at (0, link, false). Said as proved.

passages.en: Every choice an old way of telling apart allowed survives a new one exactly where the new merges nothing the old kept apart. Merge one such pair and some old choice is gone.
passages.zh: 新的分法保住旧分法允许的每一种选择，恰好是在它没有把旧分法分开的任何两样合到一起的时候。只要合了这样一对，就有某种旧的选择没了。
passages.why: keeps_through_iff is an iff for an old equivalence and any new relation; lost_choice gives the lost selection. Nothing moves a lumping, so line. The origin is any condition in which the pair was told apart; c1.open is the one in this row.

passages.en: In a built process, rebuilding the link away loses the difference it told, and correcting is then off though a unit is left.
passages.zh: 一个构造的过程：把那个环节拆掉，原来分得出的差别就没了；这时还剩一份存量，也改不了。
passages.why: closes_choice: from (2, link) rebuilding it away gives (1, no link): the selection 'is true' is through the first lumping and not the second, and correction is not enabled.

passages.en: Where the thing follows a fixed law through finitely many states, trying repeating patterns and dropping each that misses, it guesses at every step from that number on and misses fewer than a bound that number sets, never without end.
passages.zh: 实情按固定的规律、在有限几种状态之间走；拿“从某一步起循环”的说法一个个试，猜错的就排除。这样，步数到了状态数以后每一步都有猜测，猜错的次数少于由状态数定的上限，也不会没完没了地错下去。
passages.why: The third conjunct is 'does not miss at arbitrarily late steps'; that it comes to rest on the right one is only unrefuted (a double negation), so 'in the end misses no more' said more. The learner is elimination over repeating-pattern candidates, not any accounts; guesses come from step N on, N the number of states.

passages.en: In a built case it is shown from beyond which of two states holds; its list is cut to that one and its answer turns, where changing only what it values would have left the answer.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：从外面给它看是两种情形里的哪一种；它的单子就剩那一种，回答也转了；光改它看重什么，回答是不会变的。
passages.why: Sentence kept word for word; a law is added. What it says (shown, the answer turns; revalued, the answer stays) is shown_turns. shown_course is the same along the joint law's course: by the reference, holding for the answer falls short by one at step one and by nothing at step two.

passages.en: Where a change is foreseen, every state it could lead to from one held possible is held possible, ruled out before or not; while changes are recorded as the kind they are and reports fit, the actual stays among them.
passages.zh: 预料到会变，凡是这个变化能从某个还认为可能的状态通向的状态，就都算作可能，不管先前排除过没有；只要每次变化都按它实际的那一类记下、报告也都对得上，实际情形就一直在其中。
passages.why: prediction_contains_successor is for every successor of every world held possible, which is what reopens a ruled-out account; 'widens' is not general (a steady or fault-only change reopens nothing). lawful_history_preserves_known needs lawful reads as well as lawful moves and a start with the actual among the possible. Universal within this bounded model.

passages.en: In built cases a reset foreseen after a scan opens all the accounts again and a check that had passed now fails; a change of control foreseen after the last report opens them all as well.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：扫描之后预料到一次重置，所有说法都重新打开，原先通过的核验现在不通过了；最后一次报告之后预料到控制上的一次改动，也一样全部打开。
passages.why: The second theorem is about predicting a control change on the scan's result, not a change made: 'made' becomes 'foreseen'. The first reader's statement field misread the masks: 3 and 7 are sets of models (two of three, then all three), not counts.

passages.en: Built cases: the thing moves while the change is recorded as none, the actual falls outside what is held possible, a check still passes; or the standard changes after the question closes, leaving one view over two different answers.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：实情动了，记下的却是“没变”，实际情形落到了认为可能的之外，核验还照样通过；或者问题关了以后标准变了，同一个看法底下，该有的答案已经是两样。
passages.why: The summary after the colon gave both cases the first one's content. The closed-question case has no 'held possible' and no check passing: it proves one view and two different targets. Each case now carries what its theorem says.

passages.en: Where a look's error grows with its age, it can back an act only while its age stays within a bound set by how fast the error grows and how much room is left; past that it backs none.
passages.zh: 看法的误差随时间增长，它能支撑行动，只到一个年限为止；这个年限由误差长得多快、余地还剩多少来定。过了年限，它什么行动都支撑不了。
passages.why: The theorem is the necessary deadline only (certified implies 2*rate*age <= upper - lower - 2*sensor), with the error model supplied; it says nothing of a fresh look. The tail now says what follows: past the bound this look certifies nothing. That also brings the sentence to 40 words from 41.

passages.en: A fresh look against known references, with enough in hand to revise, through connected channels that all respond, makes what follows go exactly as it would with reports that respond.
passages.zh: 拿已知的参照重新对一次，手里够改的本钱，渠道都接通、都有反应；这样往后的进程，就和报告如实反应时的进程完全一样。
passages.why: renewed_run: for any channels with nonzero gains, a connected apparatus and at least seven units, the admitted run after inspection equals the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list. It holds whatever the earlier state, so 'as if its reports had never gone stale' is replaced by the equality proved.

passages.en: Built cases: a closed question reopened, looked at again and taken up comes out right, and not without the look; seven units renew stale channels and the repair succeeds; a place surveyed again has its report and next choice revised.
passages.zh: 构造的例子：关上的问题重新打开、再看一次、把结果用上，答案就对了，不看就不行；花七份存量把过时的渠道重新对过，修复就成了；地方重新看一遍，旧的报告和下一步的选择都跟着改。
passages.why: The cited seven-unit repair was not in the sentence, and 'the next choice with it' is proved only of the survey. 'Reopening without looking changes nothing' said more than 'does not repair'. exhausted_reopening_does_not_repair (no look left) is the same 'not without the look' and is added.

passages.en: With exactly enough for the look and none for the revision, where the references no longer match, the look spends what there was and revises nothing: the reports are not admitted, and what follows is left as it was.
passages.zh: 本钱刚好够看一次、不够改，参照又已经对不上：这一看把本钱花光，却什么都没改；报告不被采用，往后的一切照旧。
passages.why: The mismatch is a premise of the theorem, not something it shows the look finding. 'Nothing is corrected' is general only through unadmitted_holds (an unadmitted run leaves the network as it was), now cited; six_units_cannot_revise is the named instance.

passages.en: A course of acts can be carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the rest of the process allows it. Either can fail alone: a covered correction can be blocked, an allowed one can lack stock.
passages.zh: 一串动作做得成，恰好是在存量够、其余环节也允许的时候。两样各自都可能不成：存量够的纠正可能被卡住，允许的纠正可能缺存量。
passages.why: product_feasible_iff is exact and general; the two built cases show each side failing alone. The far side of the line is 'the act can be carried out', which no condition of this row names; c1.checked is where the enacted correction leads in the built run, so the arrow is the nearest fit, not an identity.

passages.en: In a built run, a supplied controller forms the link, which uses up the stock, then refills it and corrects at the next step. Its preference for forming the link is supplied, not derived.
passages.zh: 一个构造的进程：外给的控制先接上环节，存量用完了；再补一份，下一步就改过来了。它偏向先接环节，是外给的，不是推出来的。
passages.why: controlled_revision: rebuild at step one, the finer lumping with correction not enabled at step two, replenish, correct at step three with the response going from false to true. The run starts with no stock and no link, so its first steps pass c1.same.

passages.en: Seeing what to correct but lacking the stock or link it needs is being stopped for want of one thing: what it is made of is there, and it can go on when the missing thing comes.
passages.zh: 看出该改什么，却缺要用的存量或环节，就是“缺一样，卡住了”：它本身都在，缺的那样来了就能接着走。
passages.why: 'Goes on' becomes 'can go on': with the missing unit supplied the correction is open (opens_by_support) and executable; that it is then taken is shown only for the supplied controller. The Chinese already said 'can'. opens_by_support added; d2.stalled's own gloss says 'could go on'.

stays.en: What it has not tried, nothing in its record fixes, so a view wrong only there fits every step; in a built case, moves in step with what the view leaves out let a wrong view fit every step.
stays.zh: 它没试过的那一步，记录里什么都定不了；所以只错在那里的看法每一步都对得上。一个构造的例子里，动作一直跟着看法漏掉的东西走，错的看法每一步也都对得上。
stays.why: The second half was said as a general law; confounded is one built process, now marked. 'Fits every step' is stepsOf_retarget (every retargeting of an untaken move admits the run), added. floor_forgoes is not said here and is carried by the needs passage, so it leaves this list.

stays.en: While all it takes in agrees, what it holds and what it does agree too, so it acts the same in both; seeking among trials that tie two accounts keeps their order.
stays.zh: 只要收到的都一样，它留着的和做的也都一样，所以它在两种情形里做的是同一件事；在一样对待两种说法的试验里怎么找，它们的次序也不变。
stays.why: 'Nothing it does from there parts the two states' is not proved: agent_through_sensory gives the same internal state and act while the sensed values agree, and the two states may still answer that one act differently (sensed_alike_iff). observed_alike is about two courses under a relation every step keeps; nothing here said it, so it is dropped.

stays.en: Any course of acts that opens no fresh look keeps the view the same in both histories and leaves what it is of different; in a built case, with no new references, every later update leaves things as they were.
stays.zh: 不重新去看，不管走什么样的步子，两段经历里的看法都一样，实情却还是不同；一个构造的例子里，没有新的参照，往后每一次更新都让事情照旧。
stays.why: The first half is right for the model's closed-local acts, under any policy reading the view. false_success_stalls is one named case (identity references, changed channels) at every step, not a general law; now marked built.

stays.en: An account stays open exactly while every later answer bearing on it allows it; once ruled out, no later answer brings it back.
stays.zh: 一种说法留着，恰好是在往后每一个相关的结果都容得下它的时候；一旦排除，往后哪个结果都找不回它。
stays.why: run_stays_iff is the iff along a run; run_narrows gives that a candidate after a later step was one after every earlier step; kept_iff is the same on the loop. Said as proved.

stays.en: A listed account that predicts as the thing answers throughout a range the thing never leaves is never dropped; a report that fits the actual state never removes it from what is held possible.
stays.zh: 单子上的一种说法，在实情始终不离开的一个范围里处处预料得和实情的回应一样，就永远不会被排除；对得上实际情形的报告，也不会把实际情形从认为可能的里面去掉。
stays.why: faithful_kept needs the account to predict as the world answers everywhere in a region the world's moves keep, from a start inside it; 'the range it was checked in' made that a range of past checks. received_actual_retained was cited and unsaid; its clause is added.

stays.en: In the built process, correcting is out of reach exactly while no unit is left or the link is not formed, either lack alone blocking it; forming the link also needs a unit.
stays.zh: 在构造的过程里，纠正做不了，恰好是在没有剩下的存量、或者环节没接上的时候；缺其中任何一样就够卡住。接上环节本身也要花一份存量。
stays.why: Both are exact thresholds of one built process (Revising), so it is marked and 'exactly' is said. rebuild_enabled_iff was cited and unsaid: rebuilding the link is enabled exactly where a unit is held.

conditions.says_en: The view has just been set beside what it is of, where it could have come out otherwise. It fits as of that look.
conditions.says_zh: 看法刚刚和它所说的实情对过，而且本来有可能对不上。就这一次对照来说，它是对的。
conditions.why: The anchors exist and fit. 'As of that look' is also what Becoming.Learning.no_prefix_fixes_next and ChangingDependency.error_growth_budget say; either could be added as an anchor.

conditions.says_en: The difference is told apart, or the correction is known, but the act it calls for cannot be carried out: the stock, the parts or the link it needs are not there.
conditions.says_zh: 差别分出来了，或者知道该怎么改，但改不动：要用的存量、零件或者环节不在。
conditions.why: Executable exactly where covered and admitted; correction needs the link and a unit; the unfunded look meets the mismatch and cannot revise. All four anchors exist.

conditions.says_en: The view was right when it was taken. What it is of has changed since, the change did not enter the view, and nothing inside the view shows the difference.
conditions.says_zh: 看法在形成的时候是对的。后来实情变了，变化没进到看法里，看法自己也显不出差别。
conditions.why: The judgment is correct when taken up (learned_without_production), the reference then changes, and the two closed histories share one view under every closed-local policy. The gloss says no more than that.

conditions.says_en: Several accounts still fit, and what comes back can tell them apart. Each answer can only remove; what is removed stays out unless a change is taken into the view.
conditions.says_zh: 还有几种说法都讲得通，回来的结果能把它们分开。每个结果只能排除；排除掉的不会回来，除非看法把一次变化算了进去。
conditions.why: The first reader's correction is right. A ruled-out account returns only where a foreseen change could lead to it from one still held (prediction_contains_successor); where the thing changes and the change is recorded as none, the accounts stay out and the view is stale (understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence).

conditions.says_en: It chooses by its view, and what it chooses brings back only what the view expected. The view stands, right or wrong, though something it does not try would show which.
conditions.says_zh: 它照自己的看法来选，选出来的又只带回看法料到的结果。看法就这么立着，对也好错也好；它没试的那条路，本来能分出对错。
conditions.why: An unrefuted loop rests in either world; an untaken move is fixed by no record; in the built pair the untried act is what separates the worlds. Anchors exist and fit.

conditions.says_en: Two states of things that differ give it the same of everything it takes in. So it treats them alike; telling them apart needs something it does not now have.
conditions.says_zh: 两种不同的情形，传到它这里的东西完全一样。所以它一样对待；要分开，得有它现在没有的东西。
conditions.why: Alike inputs give the same internal state and act (agent_through_sensory); a pair tied under every experiment stays tied over all seeking. 'Treats them alike' is exactly what is proved, and is what the stay's sentence now says too.

missing.en: Where each act at a state has one outcome, the record fixes what an act does there exactly where it has been taken there; another act's outcome is fixed only once the course returns to that state and takes it.
missing.zh: 每个状态下每个动作只有一种结果时，记录定得出某个动作在某个状态下的结果，恰好是在这个动作在那里做过的时候；别的动作的结果，要等进程回到那个状态、并且做了它，才定得下来。
missing.why: The first reader used only the untaken half, in the stay. With fixes_of_takes it is an exact line for a determined process with two configurations: fixed if and only if taken. It says on which side a course stands; that a course varies its acts or returns is not derived.

missing.en: No guess from a finite record is right on every way the thing could go on. Trying repeating patterns and dropping each that misses comes to rest on right guesses only where the thing's course repeats from some step on.
missing.zh: 从有限的记录作出的猜测，没有哪一个在实情往下走的每一种可能上都对。拿循环的说法一个个试、猜错就排除，这样要停在猜对上，只有实情的进程从某一步起自己循环才行。
missing.why: The necessary side of the elimination law, from the same file. no_prefix_fixes_next holds of every predictor and every prefix, given two values; lasso_of_rest: rest on right guesses from some step implies the course repeats. It is why c1.checked says 'as of that look'.

missing.en: In a built case, after a foreseen change the scan is run again and one account is left, but one unit short of what the act then needs: the act is not completed. With that unit it is.
missing.zh: 一个构造的例子：预料到变化之后重新扫描一遍，只剩下一种说法，可是这时离动作要用的还差一份存量：动作做不完。多这一份，就做完了。
missing.why: With 22 units the second scan leaves the one right model and the command does not complete (20 spent, 2 left); with 23 it completes with nothing left. The looking uses what the act needed, as opens_without_correction shows from c1.same.

checked.notes:
AI-written second reading. I read the vocabulary, settle-view.json, the Lean statement and docstring of every cited law, and the cards. I wrote no file and ran no test, build or git command.

**Laws.** Every law the first reader names exists under the name given. Those outside Becoming/ are where the first reader says they are.

**What changed.**
- Fifteen of 24 passages are corrected: 12 in the sentence (two with a law added), two in the laws only (the fourth and the fourteenth, sentence word for word), and one moved.
- Moved: the alike_of_kept passage goes from c1.road → c1.checked to c1.road → c1.open. Its theorem concludes sensing alike or apart, and the kept task is the second world's.
- Five of six stays are corrected. The c1.same stay claimed that nothing it does parts the two states; only "it acts the same in both" is proved.
- The condition glosses stand as the first reader left them, including the c1.open fix.
- Kinds are unchanged.

**Recurring slips.**
- A built case said as a general law (the Confound half of the c1.road stay, false_success_stalls, the Revising thresholds).
- A premise dropped (one start; the answer being the value already sensed; reads lawful as well as moves; the mismatch as a premise).
- A summary clause that gave two cases the content of one (checked → old, old → checked).
- In a statement field only: the masks 3 and 7 in TemporalInspection are sets of models (two of three, then all three), not "three of seven".

**For the coordinator to decide.**
- c1.nomeans → c1.checked, line: the far side of product_feasible_iff is "the act can be carried out", which no c1 condition names. I kept the arrow as the nearest fit; the alternative is to hold it only as c1.nomeans's stay.
- c1.road → e2.rest: kept as law, not same, because rest needs the world to stay and the answer to be the value already held. Confound.confounded is a road course that keeps changing.

**Stays the schema had no slot for.**
- c1.road: Becoming.ReadingLoop.Loop.kept_alike. Candidates predicting alike along the course are kept or dropped together.
- c1.same: Becoming.Web.break_not_bounded (before the break nothing coupled in bounds how near it is), and Untested.model_or_order through observed_alike (an unresolved model and a reversed ranking look the same from outside).
- c1.old: Generative.NormativeActivity.fresh_record_can_coexist_with_stale_judgment.
- TemporalInspection.fault_movement_does_not_erase_structural_knowledge: a foreseen change of the fault alone reopens nothing. It bounds the checked → open passage.

**Not checked.** Law.Commutes.breaks and Turns.acts_alike_along, which the first reader's notes mention, are cited by no passage here.

**The first reader's not_there list.** It stands, with one addition: for c1.road → c1.checked there is now an exact line (taken or not), still with no law that has trying arise from within.

passages.en: Given to only while another has something left, and drawing at each step, it ends after that one ends, once its store is drawn down. The end runs down every such chain; a ring ends together or not at all.
passages.zh: 只在另一个还有剩的时候才得到补给、每一步又都要耗一些的，那一个尽了，它把存的耗完也就尽了。尽顺着每一条这样的链往下传；连成一圈的，要么一起尽，要么都不尽。
passages.statement: In whole numbers, where i gets nothing once nothing is left of j and i's draw is positive: once j stays within its draw, i falls by its draw each step and is nothing within as many steps as its level; j's end ends i and everything downstream; two each downstream of the other end together or not at all.

passages.en: A whole that stands only while every part stands ends as soon as one part ends. A line whose later members all lean on conditions drawn past their renewal has no member afterwards, whatever it had won inside.
passages.zh: 每个部分都在它才在的整体，只要有一个部分尽了，它就尽了。一条传承，后来的成员全都靠着一些被取用得超过补给的条件，那么过后它一个成员也没有，不管它在里面争到过多少。
passages.statement: A whole of every part ends once one part ends, and persists from T exactly where every part does. Under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, gated renewal and n steps of excess from a stock below n + m, a lineage confined to the family has no member after T + n.

passages.en: After a family of conditions is drawn past its renewal, every member of a later generation descends from one that did not depend on those conditions: only what did not lean on them goes on.
passages.zh: 一组条件被取用得超过了补给之后，后来每一代的成员，都出自不靠这组条件的那一支：还能延续下去的，只有原本就不靠它们的。
passages.statement: Under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, gated renewal and n steps of excess from a stock below n + m, every member of a later generation is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at a need of at least m.

passages.en: Built case: of two lines rising inside one body, the one confined to it ends with it; the one whose descendant needs something outside the body still has a member one generation past the end.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：在同一个身体里兴起的两支，只靠这个身体的一支跟着尽了；后代要的是身体之外的东西的那一支，过了终点还多有一代成员。
passages.statement: In the witness Body the spreading lineage, not confined to the body, has a member at the second generation (computed equality).

passages.en: Where each waits a set number of steps before answering, lapses shorter than that pass: each gives at every step but its own lapses. A lapse as long as the wait is answered next step by all waiting on it.
passages.zh: 各自都肯等一段固定步数再回应的地方：比这短的中断都过得去，各自除了自己中断的那几步，每一步都照给。中断一长到这段步数，下一步所有等着它的都不给了。
passages.statement: From all giving under a window of w, where no formation errs at w consecutive steps, each gives at every step exactly where it does not err; w + 1 consecutive errors at one formation, under a window of w + 1, make every formation waiting on it withhold at the step after.

passages.en: Under ways of giving that keep holding back once both have held back two steps running, both lapsing together for two steps in a row ends all giving for good, whatever lapses come after.
passages.zh: 要是规则是双方连着两步都不给、就一直不给：那么双方同时连着两步出了差错，从此两边都不再给，之后出不出差错都一样。
passages.statement: For a pair of laws keeping mutual withholding, where both formations err at steps t + 1 and t + 2, both withhold at every step from t + 1 on, whatever the errors after.

passages.en: Among ways of giving that look one step back and keep mutual giving, making up a single lapse and stopping giving to one that never gives hold together exactly where each gives when its last move matched the other's.
passages.zh: 只看上一步、双方都给就接着给的规则里，一次中断能补回来、对一直不给的又能停给，这两样同时成立，恰好是在这样的规则下：自己上一步和对方一样，才给。
passages.statement: For a one-step pair law with f true true = true: restoring after one withholding and answering a constant withholder hold together iff f a b = (a == b); agreement does not keep inclusion.

passages.en: Allowing for listed sets of others to stop, a member gives next step whichever listed set has stopped exactly where any two listed sets leave one it waits on outside both; built without that, one listed stop halts all.
passages.zh: 给自己列好了别的哪几组可能停的，下一步不管哪一组停了都照给，恰好是在这样的时候：任意两组之外，总还剩一个它等的。造出来的一例没有这一条：列着的一组一停，全都停了。
passages.statement: Under the certificate law, a domain gives at step 1 from every start withholding exactly an admitted fault set iff every two admitted fault sets leave a roster domain outside both; with a correlated envelope a withholding within an admitted set makes every domain withhold at step 1.

passages.en: Built case: a pair each giving while the other gave in either of its last two steps makes up a single lapse and gives together after; facing one that never gives, it gives once more, then stops for good.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：两方各自只要对方前两步里给过一次就给；一次中断补得回来，此后一直一起给。碰上一直不给的，它再给一次，然后就永远不给了。
passages.statement: Under the window of two, after one withholding the pair is (true, true) at every step from 1; against a constant withholder the holder withholds at every step from 2.

passages.en: A line ends only by a step that leaves what it had kept the same: no step that keeps it can be the last. This holds whatever is read as continuing.
passages.zh: 一条线要尽，只能经过一步，离开它一直保持不变的那一部分：守着这一部分的步子，不会是最后一步。不管把什么看作接续，都是这样。
passages.statement: For every relation E: a step under E into an end leaves the core of E; a line under E to an end reaches it by a step that continues under E and leaves its core.

passages.en: A rule taught by its holders, from a steady state, newcomers always on offer, unrevised, is held for good exactly where holders stay longer than teaching takes, some are let in, and together they take within what comes back.
passages.zh: 由持守的一方来教的规则，从稳态出发，一直有新来的可收，规则不改：它每一步都有持守的，恰好是在这样的时候：持守的时间比教会所需的长，至少收进一个，合起来取用的不超过补回来的。
laws: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»
passages.statement: Taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, from steady q L with L ≥ 1: held at every step iff teaching age < tenure, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g.

passages.en: Built cases: a line favoured by selection at every generation but its last still ends; a rule inside its band, set to admit none and then restored, is left with empty cohorts and soon has no holder.
passages.zh: 造出来的几例：一条传承在每一代都受选择偏爱，只有最后一代不是，照样尽了；一条在带内的规则，被改成一个不收、再改回来，留下几茬空缺，不久就一个持守的都没有了。
passages.statement: Witnesses: concordance positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort, empty from N + 1; exact at step 0 only, empty from cohort 3; a band state revised to 0 and back is gone at step 18.

passages.en: Where whatever carries a pattern either carried it before or was handed it, a step with no carrier is followed by none: once gone, it returns only where something starts carrying it without being handed it.
passages.zh: 要是凡承载这个格局的，要么之前就承载着，要么是被传给的：那么某一步一个承载的都没有，以后也就一直没有。没了以后要再出现，只能有什么不经传给就开始承载它。
passages.statement: Under the passing premise, a pattern present at a step is present at every earlier step; absent at t, it is absent at every t' ≥ t.

passages.en: A carrier with no replacement part, or a reserve below what correction and the move to its successor take, or a copy differing from what it carries, cannot take its step: no successor comes at that step.
passages.zh: 承载的一方没有替换的零件，或者储备不够修正加上迁到后继的花费，或者抄过去的和它承载的不一样，这一步就走不了：这一步没有后继出来。
passages.statement: In the succession model the step returns none where parts = 0, where budget < fee + migration, or where the copied payload differs from the carrier's.

passages.en: Where each copy draws a fixed amount from one stock, a run of rounds of copying completes exactly where the stock covers all they draw; short of it, the run does not complete.
passages.zh: 每复制一份都要从同一份存量里取固定的量：若干轮复制走得完，恰好是存量够付这些轮全部要取的；不够，就走不完。
passages.statement: Each unit drawing d and becoming b, n rounds from k units with stock m have a trace iff d · (k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k) ≤ m, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock.

passages.en: Built cases: a stock one unit short leaves the last copy one piece short, all material kept; a pool lacking one kind stops growth with work left; a practice whose checker leaves first, or that admits before a tested retry, fails.
passages.zh: 造出来的几例：存量差一个单位，最后一份就少一块，材料一点没丢；料池缺一种，生长就停下，力气还有剩；一个做法，负责检查的先走了，或者没经过检验过的重试就收新的，就做不成。
passages.statement: Computed runs: chains of 8, 8, 8, 7 with all 32 units of material kept; growth stops after one token with seven tokens and seven units left; the practice run returns none.

passages.en: Built cases: a change that sets nothing aside for stopping spends its reserve partway; nothing is released, no next step comes, the stop is refused and the activity runs on. A re-forming given too little work fails.
passages.zh: 造出来的几例：一次改动没给停下留余量，做到一半储备就用光了：什么都没放出来，下一步不来，停的指令被拒，活动照旧在跑。一次重组给的工作量不够，就做不成。
passages.statement: Computed runs: with nine units, after the first write nothing is published, tick and the command return none, nine are spent and the target still runs; reform with work 1 returns none.

passages.en: Built case: where the two cases can be told apart but no stock is left to act, one unit replenished opens the correction; where the link that tells them apart is off, rebuilding it, at a unit's cost, opens it.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：两种情形分得开，却没有存量可动，补进一个单位，修正就走得通了；分开两种情形的那条联系断了，花一个单位把它接上，也走得通。
passages.statement: On the revising process, from (0, link on) replenishing reaches a correctable configuration; from the link off with at least two units, rebuilding the link opens the correction in one step.

passages.en: Seeing what to change but lacking the means is being stopped for want of one thing, seen from the view: the stock, part or link the act needs is not there, and what is there stays.
passages.zh: 看出了该改什么、却没本钱改，从看法这一边看，就是缺一样卡住了：动手要用的存量、零件或联系不在，在的都还在。
passages.statement: With the link on and no stock, no acceptable executable correction exists; with no part, the carrier's step returns none.

stays.en: It holds while what it leans on holds: a whole of every part lasts exactly while every part does, and a link that draws nothing is never drained and shields what leans on it (built).
stays.zh: 所靠的在，它就在：每个部分都在它才在的整体，恰好在每个部分都在的时候延续；一环要是一点不耗，就不会被耗干，靠着它的也就保住了（造出来的一例）。

stays.en: Nothing in the laws keeps it: read in time it holds from a step only while exchanges go on after it, and a built pair is tied from its first step and not from its second.
stays.zh: 定律里没有什么让它保持：按时间先后看，它只在某一步之后还有往来时才从那一步起成立；造出来的一对，从第一步起连着，从第二步起就不连了。

stays.en: A group giving at the start, each waiting on no more outside it than it can do without, gives at every step whatever the rest do; lapses shorter than each one's wait leave each giving but at its own.
stays.zh: 一开始都在给的一群，各自在群外等的不超过自己少得起的，不管其余怎样，每一步都照给；中断短过各自肯等的步数，各自除了自己中断的那几步都照给。

stays.en: Without memory, on a loop of waits a lapse never dies out: it comes back at every turn round the loop; in a built ring of three exactly one holds back at every step, for ever.
stays.zh: 不记前账的时候，在一圈“等”里，中断不会消失：绕一圈回来一次；造出来的三方一圈里，每一步恰好有一个不给，永远如此。

stays.en: Where none can do without all it waits on, or each gives only if it gave before, nothing given at one step means nothing given at any later step; an empty start stays empty.
stays.zh: 要是哪一个都少不了它所等的全部，或者各自都要自己上一步给过才给：某一步全都不给，以后每一步也全都不给；一开始就空着的，一直空着。

stays.en: While it lasts it is handed on at least once in every stretch as long as one carrier lasts, a built relay meeting that pace; where selection favours it at ever later steps, every generation has a member.
stays.zh: 它还在的时候，每过一茬那么长的时间，至少往下传一次，造出来的接力正好是这个速度；要是在越来越后的步子上一直还有选择偏向它，每一代都有成员。

stays.en: The step stays blocked while the part, the reserve or the faithful copy it needs is missing; nothing inside the step supplies it, and in a built case the totals look safe meanwhile.
stays.zh: 缺的零件、储备或者没抄错的副本不来，这一步就一直走不了；这一步自己补不出来，造出来的一例里，总账这时看着还很安全。

conditions.says_en: Nothing comes to it once nothing is left of another. Drawing something at each step, it ends after that one ends, at once or once its store is used. It need give nothing back to the one it leans on.
conditions.says_zh: 另一个一点不剩，它就什么也得不到。它每一步都要耗一些，那一个尽了，它也尽，立刻，或者等存的用完。它不必给所靠的那一个什么回报。
conditions.why: The cascade needs a positive draw on the dependent: with a draw of nothing the link outlasts what it leans on (Chain.stopped), and the gloss left that premise out. 'None of this comes back' is not in the laws: a ring of such leaning ends together (ends_together).

conditions.says_en: What any one does can reach, at some remove, every other's going on, and so comes back to it. Taking counts as much as giving: this is contact, not kindness. Read in time, the reach can stop after some step.
conditions.says_zh: 哪一个做了什么，隔着几层，都够得着其余每一个的延续，也就绕回它自己。取和给一样算：这说的是相连，不是善意。按时间先后看，这种够得着可能到某一步就断了。
conditions.why: MutuallyDependent is read across all steps: it can hold where nothing affects anything in time (LatePair.apart), and in time it can lapse (Drawing.lapses). 'Sooner or later' claimed reach in time. The part about taking is right (returning_feeding_apart).

conditions.says_en: Each gives because what it waits on gave, so the giving carries itself on. A lapse passes without spreading only where each can do without a few of those it waits on, or waits out a lapse shorter than its window.
conditions.says_zh: 各自都因为所等的给了才给，于是给就这么接下去。中断能过去、不传开，只在这样的地方：各自少几个也照给，或者中断短过它肯等的步数。
conditions.why: A lapse passing is a property of tolerating or windowed laws only; with memory (waitsAll) every lapse spreads along the waits (withholding_spreads), so the gloss stated as general what holds only under some laws.

conditions.says_en: At least one has stopped giving while others still give. The gap is then passed over, answered by what waits on it, spreads along every chain of waits from it, or goes round a loop of waits for ever.
conditions.says_zh: 至少有一个不给了，别的还在给。这个缺口要么被带过去，要么等着它的跟着不给，要么顺着每一条“等”的链传下去，要么在一圈“等”里一直转。
conditions.why: A withholding spreads only to what lies downstream along the waits, not to all; and without memory on a loop it circulates for ever (withholding_returns, answers_circulates), a fourth way the gloss left out.

conditions.says_en: Nothing gives, because each gives only after another has. It stays so until something gives without waiting, or something already in hand is spent to start.
conditions.says_zh: 全都不给，因为各自都要等对方先给。会一直这样，直到有一个不等就给，或者拿手头现成的先垫上。
conditions.why: English true to the laws (gives_needs_sparing, total_stays, the reserve's ignition). Chinese as already settled: 谁 is a word for persons; this sheet still carries the old Chinese.

conditions.says_en: The same pattern goes on while what carries it is replaced: it is handed on at least once in every stretch as long as one carrier lasts.
conditions.says_zh: 承载它的换了一茬又一茬，同一个格局还在：每过一茬那么长的时间，至少往下传了一次。
conditions.why: As already settled: passes_within gives a passing by some carrier in every stretch of a carrier's span, not a passing by each carrier within its own span. This sheet still carries the old wording.

conditions.says_en: The next step cannot be taken because one needed thing is missing. What it is made of is still there, and it could go on if the missing thing came.
conditions.says_zh: 下一步走不了，因为缺一样要用的东西。它本身还在，缺的那样来了，就能接着走。
conditions.why: True to the laws: the step returns none for a missing part, reserve or faithful copy; material is kept (partial_failure_keeps_material); replenishing opens the correction (opens_by_support). 'Could go on' is shown only in built cases, and the refused stop (RecoverableControl) shows a stall in which the activity runs on.

not_there: d0.line to d0.ring, and back: no law says how one-way leaning becomes mutual or how mutual dependence forms; it is supplied.
d0.ring to coming apart: a built pair shows mutual reach lapsing in time, but no law says when it lapses, and the map has no condition for being apart (Drawing.lapses, LatePair.apart, the Cuts laws).
d0.line to a2.short under partial dependence: the cascade is proved only where giving stops entirely; giving that falls without stopping is open.
d1.gap or d1.wait to d0.line or a2.ended: the waiting laws carry no amounts, so no law joins a lapse of giving to the drawing down or end of what lives on that giving.
d1.wait to d1.round from inside the course: every way out needs a change of the law of giving (giving first, sparing) or a reserve from before; no law shows a law of waiting changing itself.
d2.stalled to d2.handed: no general law that the missing thing arrives or that a stalled carrier takes up handing on again; only built cases of a correction opening.
written.notes:
I read the Lean statements for every law I cite (RegimeMargin, Wholes, Founding, MutualDependence, ConditionInTime, FlowCenters, Withholding, Tolerance, FaultEnvelopes, WindowedWaiting, PairChance, PatternPassing, RuleRebuilding, GrammarRegularity, SelectionShift, Copying, OpenedCorrection, and the periphery AlignmentSuccession, JointPracticeContinuation, RecurrentAssembly, RecoverableControl, GoalFormationRevision). I changed no file and ran no build.

Main additions. The cascade's own laws (ends_after, ends_of_partner, ends_downstream, ends_together) were not in the items: only its witness Chain.stopped was there. I wrote d0.line to a2.ended from them, and used Chain.stopped as the stay that marks its edge. I added the survivors_independent law (needs) for d0.line to a2.else beside the Body witness. I added a2.ended to d2.handed (needs) from ByPassing.empty_stays and present_of_le: under the passing premise a pattern once gone never comes back.

Placements I changed from the readers'. PairChance.burst_absorbs is round to wait, not gap to wait, so it does not repeat the settled memory law. FailedRenewal.lines_gain is already settled as a2.short to a2.supplied (settled log), so I left it out. The readers placed AlignmentSuccession and JointPractice at a2.short; I put them at d2.stalled, because in them the carrier is still there and only the step returns none. RecoverableControl (a1.up in the reader) I put as a1.over to d2.stalled: the reserve is spent partway through. That from-condition is a judgment. OpenedCorrection I drew as d2.stalled to a2.supplied (built). c1.nomeans to d2.stalled is marked 'same', but c1.nomeans is really the case of d2.stalled in which the view already sees: a reader may prefer 'within'.

Items that belong to no passage here:
- The regularity laws («后皆续当且仅当后皆同类», «亡而网续则后不皆续», Unclosed.not_taken_in, Inconstant.not_all_follow) are about what lies on a line under a class. They meet none of these conditions and belong with the 'uncounted' places of the b rows.
- The Cuts laws and GrownFragmentation are about one piece against apart in a symmetric closure. They are not mutual dependence, and the map has no condition for them.
- exponential_around bounds the most a difference can carry round a loop whose links act at every step, which is a supplied premise. It is not actual growth, and belongs to e1.ring to e2.grow if anywhere.
- Flow.carried_keeping_above_ending derives nothing about the stake (its realization premise is the identity).
- GoalFormationRevision.crossed_loss_blocks_simple_revision would need a reading of its periphery model before it could be placed (the reader put it b2.felt to d2.stalled).
- Generations.allWhole_never contrasts the two wholes of the same parts: the whole of every member never stands while the lineage stands at every step. That is a contrast between d0.line-like and d2.handed-like wholes, not a passage. It could go in d2.handed's own text.
- MutualActivation.saves (support can save) was in the dynamic but not in the items.

d1.wait and d2.handed already have fixes in settled.json; this sheet still carries their old wording, so I repeat the settled wording.

passages.en: Given to only while another has something left, and drawn on at every step, it ends after that one ends, once its store is used. The end runs down every such chain; a ring ends together or not at all.
passages.zh: 只在另一个还有剩的时候才得到补给、每一步又都被取走一些的：那一个尽了，它把存的耗完也就尽了。尽顺着每一条这样的链往下传；连成一圈的，要么一起尽，要么都不尽。
passages.why: All five laws are real and say this, in whole numbers, with a positive draw on every dependent (stated). One word changed: in the Lean the draw is taken from the dependent itself; 'drawing' could be read as its drawing on the other, which the model does not have.

passages.en: A whole that stands only while every part stands ends once one part ends. A line all of whose later members need conditions renewed only by what needs them and drawn down below that need ends, whatever it won inside.
passages.zh: 每个部分都在它才在的整体，只要有一个部分尽了，它就尽了。一条传承，后来的成员全都需要一组条件，这组条件只由需要它们的来补给，又被取用到低于这份需要：这条传承就尽了，不管它在里面争到过多少。
passages.why: confined_ends needs the gate (whatever gives to the family itself needs it at the need m) and a stock drawn below that need; 'drawn past their renewal' alone does not end a line, since renewal from elsewhere could resume. The flow's standing premises (balance, only the active give, activity needs support, descent) are left unsaid. persists_iff belongs to the stay, not here.

passages.en: Where a family of conditions, renewed only by what needs it, is drawn past its renewal until it falls below a need: every later member is the offspring of one that needed none of those conditions that much.
passages.zh: 一组条件只由需要它们的来补给，又被取用得超过补给、降到某个需要量以下：此后每一代的成员，都出自一个并不那么需要这组条件的成员。
passages.why: The theorem excludes only dependence at a need of at least m: the parent may still need the family at less. 'Did not depend on those conditions' said more. The gate premise was missing. Kind and ends are right: a necessary condition for going on after the family's end.

passages.en: Built case: of two lines rising inside one body, the one confined to it ends with it; the one whose descendant needs something outside the body still has a member one generation past the end.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：在同一个身体里兴起的两支，只靠这个身体的一支跟着尽了；后代要的是身体之外的东西的那一支，过了终点还多有一代成员。
passages.why: Matches the witness: the confined lineage is empty from the second generation, the spreading one has a member there (a computed equality) and its descendant needs one of the outside condition and nothing of the body. The witness models nothing after that generation.

passages.en: From all giving, where each waits a set number of steps before answering: shorter lapses pass, each giving except at its own lapses; a lapse as long as the wait is answered next step by all waiting on it.
passages.zh: 从全都在给出发，各自都要等上一段固定步数才回应：比这短的中断都过得去，各自除了自己中断的那几步都照给；中断长到这段步数，下一步所有等着它的都不给了。
passages.why: Both laws run from the start in which all give (erringStart); from another start the first half fails (no window restores from total withholding), so the start is a premise and is now said. The threshold is exact: no w consecutive lapses under a window of w, against w + 1 under a window of w + 1.

passages.en: Under ways of giving that keep holding back once both have held back two steps running, both lapsing together for two steps in a row ends all giving for good, whatever lapses come after.
passages.zh: 要是规则是双方连着两步都不给、就一直不给：那么双方同时连着两步出了差错，从此两边都不再给，之后出不出差错都一样。
