passages.why: Says what burst_absorbs proves, for a pair, for every pair of laws keeping mutual withholding and every error pattern after the burst. The theorem holds from any earlier course, so the start may as well be a gap; round is a fair origin.

passages.en: In a pair, among one-step ways of giving that keep mutual giving, exactly one both makes up a single lapse and, at some step, holds back from a partner never giving: giving just when its last move matched the partner's.
passages.zh: 两方之间，只看上一步、双方都给就接着给的规则里，恰好只有一条既能把一次中断补回来、又会在某一步对一直不给的对方停给：自己上一步和对方一样，才给。
passages.why: The theorem is an iff over the one-step laws of a pair: it says which rule does both, and shows nothing moving a rule across, so it is a line. Answering is withholding at some step, not for good (agreement gives again at every even step), so 'stopping giving' said more. agreement_not_keeps was cited but not said; the split it belongs to is added as a missing passage.

passages.en: Allowing for listed sets of others to stop, a member gives next step whichever listed set has stopped exactly where any two listed sets leave one it waits on outside both; built without that, one listed stop halts all.
passages.zh: 给自己列好了别的哪几组可能停的，下一步不管哪一组停了都照给，恰好是在这样的时候：任意两组之外，总还剩一个它等的。造出来的一例没有这一条：列着的一组一停，全都停了。
passages.why: Matches the iff (giving at step 1 from every start withholding exactly an admitted fault set, exactly where the envelope is separated) and the witness with roster 0, 1, 2 and sets {0,1}, {2}. It speaks of one member's next step, as the sentence does.

passages.en: Built case: a pair each giving while the other gave in either of its last two steps makes up a single lapse and gives together after; facing one that never gives, it gives once more, then stops for good.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：两方各自只要对方前两步里给过一次就给；一次中断补得回来，此后一直一起给。碰上一直不给的，它再给一次，然后就永远不给了。
passages.why: Both computed courses say this: together at every step from step 1; against a constant withholder, giving at step 1 and withholding from step 2 on.

passages.en: A line ends only by a step that leaves the part of its sameness that carries itself on; a step that keeps that part is never the last. This holds whatever sameness is read as continuing.
passages.zh: 一条线要尽，最后那一步必定离开了它的“同”里能自己接续下去的那一部分；守着这一部分的步子，不会是最后一步。不管把哪一种“同”看作接续，都是这样。
passages.why: The last step still continues under the class and leaves its core, the greatest part of the sameness that is constant under the relation. 'What it had kept the same' read as the class is wrong (the step keeps the class), and read as the core it claims the line kept the core until then, which is not proved: the core may have been left earlier.

passages.en: A rule taught by its holders, from a steady state, newcomers always on offer, unrevised, is held for good exactly where holders stay longer than teaching takes, some are let in, and all members together take within what comes back.
passages.zh: 由持守的一方来教的规则，从稳态出发，一直有新来的可收，规则不改：它每一步都有持守的，恰好是在这样的时候：持守的时间比教会所需的长，至少收进一个，全体成员合起来取用的不超过补回来的。
laws: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»
passages.why: The third conjunct is (q + e q) · s ≤ g: holders and the untaught others who still come, together. 'Together they' read as the holders alone is a weaker condition. The start also has a level of at least one, left unsaid.

passages.en: Built cases: a line whose marked members selection favours at every generation but the last still ends; a rule in its band, set to admit none and then restored, has empty cohorts and ends by overdrawing, held until then.
passages.zh: 造出来的几例：一条传承里，带标记的成员每一代都受选择偏爱，只有最后一代不是，这条传承照样尽了；一条在带内的规则，被改成一个不收、再改回来，留下几茬空缺，最后因取用超过补给而尽，尽之前一直有持守的。
passages.why: The witnesses have selection within the family favouring the marked member, not selection favouring the line. The rule's witness ends as level nothing and no member at step 18, with a holder at every step before: it is overdrawn while held, not left without holders first. exact_once_ends shows another thing (exact transmission at one step only does not give going on) and is not carried by this sentence.

passages.en: Where whatever carries a pattern either carried it before or was handed it, a step with no carrier is followed by none: once gone, it returns only where something starts carrying it without being handed it.
passages.zh: 要是凡承载这个格局的，要么之前就承载着，要么是被传给的：那么某一步一个承载的都没有，以后也就一直没有。没了以后要再出现，只能有什么不经传给就开始承载它。
passages.why: empty_stays under the passing premise, which is supplied and stated as such; the second clause is its contrapositive. Needs is the right kind: a return breaks the premise.

passages.en: Built model of succession on funds: with no replacement part, or a reserve below what correction and the move take, or a copy differing from what it carries, the carrier's step is blocked and no successor comes.
passages.zh: 造出来的一个靠资金更替承载者的模型：没有替换的零件，或者储备不够修正加上迁移的花费，或者抄过去的和它承载的不一样，承载者的这一步就被挡住，没有后继出来。
passages.why: The three theorems are real and say this, but each unfolds the guard of one declared step function in a periphery machine (proved by simp on its definition): they state what that machine requires, not a course arriving at a stall. Drawn as law they would make the whole passage a law on a definition; the general statement here is the copying line.

passages.en: Where every unit draws a fixed amount from one stock each time it copies, a run of rounds of copying completes exactly where the stock covers all they draw; short of it, the run does not complete.
passages.zh: 每个单位每复制一轮，都从同一份存量里取固定的量：若干轮复制走得完，恰好是存量够付这些轮全部要取的；不够，就走不完。
passages.why: In the Lean each unit draws d a round and becomes b; the draw is per unit that copies, not per copy made. Otherwise the iff is as said.

passages.en: Built cases: a stock one unit short leaves the last copy one piece short, all material kept; a pool lacking one kind stops growth with work left; a practice whose checker leaves first, or admitting before a tested retry, fails.
passages.zh: 造出来的几例：存量差一个单位，最后一份就少一块，材料一点没丢；料池缺一种，生长就停下，力气还有剩；一个做法，负责检查的先走了，或者没经过检验过的重试就收新的，就做不成。
passages.why: Content matches the four computed runs (chains of 8, 8, 8, 7 with all 32 units kept; growth stopping after one token with seven units left; two runs returning none). One word trimmed only because the sentence ran to 41 words.

passages.en: Built case: a change that sets nothing aside for stopping spends its reserve partway; nothing is released, no next step comes, the stop is refused and the activity runs on.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：一次改动没给停下留余量，做到一半储备就用光了：什么都没放出来，下一步不来，停的指令被拒，活动照旧在跑。
passages.why: The run matches: nine units spent, nothing published, tick and the command return none, the target still running. Its reserve is drawn down with nothing coming back, so a1.over is a fair origin. The second witness does not start there: reform is given an account with one unit of work directly, with no drawing down shown; it is moved to the passage from c1.nomeans.

passages.en: Built case: two cases told apart but no stock left to act: one unit replenished opens the correction. The link that tells them apart off: rebuilding it opens the correction only where a unit is left over to act.
passages.zh: 造出来的一例：两种情形分得开，却没有存量可动：补进一个单位，修正就走得通了。分开两种情形的那条联系断着：把它接上，还得剩下一个单位可动，修正才走得通。
passages.why: opens starts from at least two units; from one unit rebuilding uses the last and no correction is possible (rebuilt_starved), so 'at a unit's cost' left out the unit that must remain. With the link off the two cases are read alike, which is c1.same more exactly than a stall; kept here because the link is the one missing thing.

passages.en: Seeing what to change but lacking the means is being stopped for want of one thing, seen from the view: the stock or part the act needs is not there. Built: a re-forming given too little work fails.
passages.zh: 看出了该改什么、却没本钱改，从看法这一边看，就是缺一样卡住了：动手要用的存量或零件不在。造出来的一例：一次重组给的工作量不够，就做不成。
passages.why: c1.nomeans is the case of d2.stalled in which the view already sees. 'And what is there stays' is not in the cited laws. 'Link' is dropped: in the correction model a link that is off means the cases are not told apart, which is not seeing. The reform witness (goal already revised, one unit of work where two are charged) belongs here.

stays.en: A whole of every part lasts exactly while every part does, needing nothing to arise. In a built chain, a link with no draw on it never drains, and what leans on it holds, though the first has ended.
stays.zh: 每个部分都在它才在的整体，恰好在每个部分都在的时候延续，用不着有什么新生出来。造出来的一条链里，有一环不被取用，它就不会被耗干，靠着它的也就保住了，尽管链头已经尽了。
stays.why: 'It holds while what it leans on holds' is proved only of the whole of every part. In the cascade's model dependence says nothing comes once the other has nothing left; it does not say something comes while the other has something.

stays.en: No law says it lasts. Read in time, once lapsed from a step it is lapsed from every later one; one built pair is tied from its first step and not from its second, another from every step.
stays.zh: 没有哪条定律说它会一直在。按时间先后看，从某一步起断了，从以后每一步起也都断了；造出来的一对，从第一步起连着，从第二步起就不连了，另一对从每一步起都连着。
stays.why: MutuallyDependentFrom.earlier says that holding from a step gives holding from every earlier step; 'only while exchanges go on after it' is a reading of the definition, not that theorem. A built pair exchanging at every step is tied from every step (Recurring.inTime), so the stay has a positive case as well.

stays.en: A group giving at the start, each waiting on no more outside it than it can spare, gives at every step whatever the rest do. From all giving, lapses shorter than the wait leave each giving except at its own.
stays.zh: 一开始都在给的一群，各自在群外等的不超过自己少得起的，不管其余怎样，每一步都照给。从全都在给出发，中断短过肯等的步数，各自除了自己中断的那几步都照给。
stays.why: kept_set is as said. gives_unless_errs holds from the start in which all give, and the window is one length for all; both now said.

stays.en: Without memory, on a loop of waits a lapse never dies out: it comes back at every turn round the loop; in a built ring of three exactly one holds back at every step, for ever.
stays.zh: 不记前账的时候，在一圈“等”里，中断不会消失：绕一圈回来一次；造出来的三方一圈里，每一步恰好有一个不给，永远如此。
stays.why: withholding_returns: the one that lapsed withholds at every multiple of the loop's length; nothing is said of the steps between, and the sentence does not claim it. The ring's course is as said.

stays.en: Where none can do without all it waits on, or each gives only if it gave before, nothing given at one step means nothing given at any later step; a built pair starting empty stays empty.
stays.zh: 要是哪一个都少不了它所等的全部，或者各自都要自己上一步给过才给：某一步全都不给，以后每一步也全都不给；造出来的一对，一开始空着，就一直空着。
stays.why: The two general laws are as said. empty_never_starts is a computed run of one built pair; 'an empty start stays empty' read as general.

stays.en: Carried only by being handed on, a lasting pattern is handed on in every stretch as long as one carrier lasts; a built relay passes no oftener. Offspring numbers varying with a mark at ever later steps, no generation empties.
stays.zh: 只靠传给才有承载的格局，只要它还在，每过一茬那么长的时间，至少往下传一次；造出来的接力正好是这个速度。要是在越来越后的步子上，成员的后代数目一直还随某个标记而不同，每一代都不空。
stays.why: passes_within needs the passing premise, which is supplied; without it only begins_within holds (some carrier begins in every such stretch). The second law's premise is that concordance or discordance of offspring number with the mark is positive at ever later steps: numbers vary with the mark, in either direction. 'Selection favours it' is not the premise.

stays.en: In the built model of succession the step is blocked wherever the part, the reserve or the faithful copy is missing, so no later state comes of it; in a built case the totals stay within bounds meanwhile.
stays.zh: 在造出来的更替模型里，凡是缺零件、缺储备或者副本抄错了的地方，这一步都被挡住，后面也就没有状态接上；造出来的一例里，总账这时还在界内。
stays.why: The theorems say the step returns none at each such state; 'stays blocked while' and 'nothing inside the step supplies it' are readings of the definition, not statements. The witness shows the market state safe under its bounds, not merely looking safe.

conditions.says_en: It goes on only while another does: once nothing is left of that one, nothing comes to it, and, drawn on at every step, it ends at once or when its store is used up. It need give nothing back to the one it leans on.
conditions.says_zh: 它只在另一个还在的时候延续：那一个一点不剩，它就什么也得不到；它每一步又都在被耗，于是立刻、或者等存的耗完，也就尽了。它不必给所靠的那一个什么回报。
conditions.why: The first reader's correction is right (a positive draw is needed; a ring of such leaning is possible) but dropped the opening sentence that also covers the two other anchors, the whole of every part and the confined line; it is restored. 'Drawing' is 'drawn on': the draw is taken from it.

conditions.says_en: What any one does can reach, at some remove, every other's going on, and so comes back to it. Taking counts as much as giving: this is contact, not kindness. Read in time, the reach can stop after some step.
conditions.says_zh: 哪一个做了什么，隔着几层，都够得着其余每一个的延续，也就绕回它自己。取和给一样算：这说的是相连，不是善意。按时间先后看，这种够得着可能到某一步就断了。
conditions.why: The first reader's wording is true to the Lean and kept: mutual dependence is read across all steps (every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other; every one's acts return), and in time it can lapse in a built pair. 'Sooner or later' claimed reach in time.

conditions.says_en: Each gives because what it waits on gave, so the giving carries itself on. A lapse passes without spreading where each can do without as many as lapsed of those it waits on, or waits out a lapse shorter than its wait; where each needs all it waits on at the last step, a lapse is passed on.
conditions.says_zh: 各自都因为所等的给了才给，于是给就这么接下去。中断能过去、不传开，是在这样的地方：所等的里面少了这么几个它也照给，或者中断短过它肯等的步数；要是各自都得所等的上一步全给了才给，中断就往下传。
conditions.why: The first reader's 'only where' says no other way of giving lets a lapse pass. The Lean shows it passing under tolerance and under a window, and passed on under the two plain laws; it does not rule out others (one that gives whatever it waits on also stops a lapse). 'Where', with the other side said.

conditions.says_en: At least one has stopped giving while others still give. The gap is then passed over, or answered by what waits on it: carried down a line of waits and off its end, round a loop of waits for ever, or, where a lapse is never made up, spread for good to all it reaches along the waits.
conditions.says_zh: 至少有一个不给了，别的还在给。这个缺口要么被带过去，要么等着它的跟着不给：顺着一串“等”传下去、到头就出去了，或者在一圈“等”里一直转，或者在中断补不回来的地方，传到顺着“等”够得着的每一个，从此都不给。
conditions.why: The first reader's four ways are right. One more is proved and already drawn as a settled passage: without memory, where no chain of waits is long enough, the lapse runs off the end (gives_without_chain). Spreading for good is the case with memory, and reaches only what lies along the waits.

conditions.says_en: Nothing gives, because each gives only after another has. It stays so until something gives without waiting, or something already in hand is spent to start.
conditions.says_zh: 全都不给，因为各自都要等对方先给。会一直这样，直到有一个不等就给，或者拿手头现成的先垫上。
conditions.why: English true to the laws and unchanged; the Chinese is the settled wording without the word for persons. The reserve's start is a built pair only.

conditions.says_en: The same pattern goes on while what carries it is replaced: it is handed on at least once in every stretch as long as one carrier lasts.
conditions.says_zh: 承载它的换了一茬又一茬，同一个格局还在：每过一茬那么长的时间，至少往下传了一次。
conditions.why: The settled wording is right: passes_within gives a passing by some carrier in every stretch of a carrier's span, under the passing premise, which is what being in this condition is.

conditions.says_en: The next step cannot be taken because one needed thing is missing. What it is made of is still there, and it could go on if the missing thing came.
conditions.says_zh: 下一步走不了，因为缺一样要用的东西。它本身还在，缺的那样来了，就能接着走。
conditions.why: True to the laws. 'Could go on if the missing thing came' is shown in the succession model for every state (enabled_step) and in a built correction (opens_by_support); material kept is a built case.

missing.en: In the built succession model, a running carrier with a part, a reserve covering correction and the move, a faithful copy and a current credential takes its step; a stalled one goes on only once what it lacks is there.
missing.zh: 在造出来的更替模型里，正在运行的承载者，有零件、储备够付修正和迁移、副本没抄错、凭证有效，这一步就走得成；卡住的那一个，要等缺的那样到了才接着走。
missing.why: The first reader listed this passage as not there. enabled_step shows the step taken for every state with all four present, and the three blocking theorems are the necessary side. Nothing in the model brings the missing thing (parts arrive only with a completed step), so it is a needs passage.

missing.en: In a pair, a one-step way of giving that keeps mutual giving and never gives less for more giving either never makes up a single lapse or never holds back from a partner that never gives.
missing.zh: 两方之间，只看上一步的规则，要是双方都给就接着给、给得多了下一步也不会给得少：那它要么永远补不回一次中断，要么永远不会对一直不给的对方停给。
missing.why: The dynamic's headline law, not in the first reader's passages: it is why the one rule that does both gives after both held back, and why the built window of two is needed. A necessary condition on the rule for making up a lapse while still answering.

missing.en: A rule taught by its holders or by none, once without a holder, has none again whatever is chosen. Taught from outside, with stock left, entrants on offer and a quota, it has holders after one step.
missing.zh: 由持守的一方来教、或者哪一方都不教的规则，一旦没有持守的，不管怎么选，就再也不会有。由外面来教的规则，只要还有存量、有新来的可收、名额不是零，过一步就又有持守的了。
missing.why: A second way on the passage the first reader drew from the passing premise: here the premise is the model's own (taught by members), the closure holds under every choice of the net, and the return is shown where the teaching comes from outside the members, which is the outside change a needs passage names.

missing.en: Among finitely many stocks, each renewed no less the more is left of any, within a band: one ends exactly where it starts below a least level, and that level is no higher where the others stand higher.
missing.zh: 有限多份存量，哪一份剩得多了，各自得到的补给都不会更少，并且都在一个带内：其中一份走到尽，恰好是它起步时低于某个最低水平；别的存量站得越高，这个水平不会更高。
missing.why: The first reader lists dependence short of total as open. These laws cover it under mutual support, in whole numbers: each one's point of no return is exact and does not rise as another's level rises. The origin is a judgment: mutual support is giving that never falls as another rises (independence included), in the model of coupled stocks, not the flow's mutual dependence; d0.ring is the nearest condition of the row, and the coordinator may hold it for a condition of partial dependence.

checked.notes:
Read only: I changed no file and ran no build, test or writing git command. I read the Lean statement and docstring of every law cited here (RegimeMargin, Wholes, Founding, ConditionInTime, FlowCenters, MutualDependence, Withholding, Tolerance, FaultEnvelopes, WindowedWaiting, PairChance, PatternPassing, GrammarRegularity, RuleRebuilding, SelectionShift, LineageRegions, Copying, OpenedCorrection, and the periphery AlignmentSuccession, SeededContinuation, RecurrentAssembly, JointPracticeContinuation, RecoverableControl, GoalFormationRevision) and set them beside cards.json where a card exists. Every law the first reader names exists under the name given.

Of 19 passages: 5 kept word for word, 14 corrected (one of them only by a word, for length). Of 7 stays: 1 kept, 6 corrected. No passage dropped or moved between conditions.

Kinds changed, two:
- d1.gap to d1.round, the one-step rule that restores and answers: law to line. It is an iff over rules; nothing moves a rule across.
- d2.handed to d2.stalled, the succession model: law to built. The three theorems unfold the guard of one declared step function. With this, the strongest way on that passage is the copying line, a general exact theorem of the core. If the coordinator reads model-wide theorems as laws throughout (as the settled rule-rebuilding ones are), this is the one to reconsider; the sentence is scoped to the model either way.

Premises that were missing and change the sense: the gate and the need in the confined line and in the survivors law; 'from all giving' in the windowed laws; the passing premise in d2.handed's stay; 'all members', not the holders alone, in the band; the unit that must remain after rebuilding the link; 'at some step' for answering a never-giver.

Sentences that said something the Lean does not: 'selection favours it' (the premise is that offspring number varies with the mark, in either direction); 'a line favoured by selection' (it is the marked member within the family); 'what it had kept the same' for the core; 'it holds while what it leans on holds' for the cascade; 'an empty start stays empty' as general; 'only where' in d1.round's gloss.

On the first reader's 'not there' list:
- d2.stalled to d2.handed is there as a needs passage in the succession model (enabled_step); added.
- Dependence short of total is not wholly open: under mutual support the point of no return is exact and does not rise as another's level rises; added as d0.ring to a1.past, with its origin marked as a judgment.
- The other four entries stand as written.

Left for the coordinator, not placed:
- OpenedCorrection.Linked.opens starts with the link off, where the two cases are read alike: that is c1.same in the view row. I kept it in the d2.stalled passage since the link is the one missing thing; it would sit more exactly as a way out of c1.same.
- RecoverableControl's origin at a1.over is a judgment (a reserve spent with nothing coming back); c1.nomeans would also fit, since the change was already prepared.
- RegimeMargin.Coupled.Relay.cycles (a built pair, each given to only while the other has something left, each ending alone, neither ending together and never at rest) is a positive built case for d0.ring's stay; left out of the sentence for length.
- AlignmentSuccession.every_generation_executes (under a certificate paying correction and the move, every generation takes its step) is the succession model's stay at d2.handed; not in the items.
- WindowedWaiting.window_withheld_kept (no window restores from total withholding) belongs with d1.wait's stay.
- SelectionShift.ExactOnce.exact_once_ends is no longer cited: it shows that exact transmission at one step only does not give going on, which no sentence here says.
- d0.ring's Chinese name in the vocabulary (谁也离不开谁) carries the word for persons; names are outside this sheet.

All English sentences are at most 40 words by whitespace count; the Chinese carries none of 人, 谁, 大家.

passages.en: Round a ring, a difference closes only through a link that passes on less than it got. Where each turn gives back less than any difference and nothing from nothing, it is gone within as many turns as its size.
passages.zh: 绕着一个环，差别只有经过一个传出去比收到少的环节才会合上。每转一圈还回来的都比差别少、零进零出，那么差别有多大，至多转那么多圈就没了。
passages.statement: If every link gives on at least what it receives, the difference is never below its start; so a fall needs a link giving less. A return map with f 0 = 0 and f x < x for x > 0 is 0 from turn d on.

passages.en: Round a ring whose every link passes on at least twice what it gets, a difference passes every bound. Where links multiply by whole numbers nothing lies between: the product closes it at once, keeps it, or grows it.
passages.zh: 环上每个环节传出去的都至少是收到的两倍，差别就越过任何界限。环节都按整数倍传时，没有中间的情形：乘积为零，一圈就合上；为一，原样留着；二以上，越滚越大。
passages.statement: Links each giving at least twice: the course exceeds every bound from a positive start. Multiplying links with product 0, 1, at least 2: closed at the first turn, kept, unbounded; never a positive fall. Doubling at returns that come often enough outgrows every power of the steps.

passages.en: Round a ring whose turn keeps a larger difference no smaller and does not raise the one it starts from, the difference never rises and, within as many turns as its size, settles where a turn leaves it as it is.
passages.zh: 环转一圈不把大的变得比小的还小，也不抬高起点，那么差别永不上升，至多转它大小那么多圈，就停在转一圈也不变的地方。
passages.statement: For a monotone return map with f d ≤ d: the course never rises, and some k ≤ d has f at the course's value equal to it, with the course constant from k on.

passages.en: Round a ring each of whose links passes on exactly what it gets, a difference comes back whole at every turn: no turn closes it and none grows it.
passages.zh: 环上每个环节收多少就传多少，差别每转一圈都原样回来：哪一圈都不合上，也不变大。
passages.statement: If every link gives on what it receives, the course of the return map is d at every turn.

passages.en: Once every push is against the departure and no larger than the gap, at every step, the level is at its mark within as many steps as the gap was wide, and stays there.
passages.zh: 只要从某一步起，每一次推回都朝偏离的反方向、又不超过缺口，水平至多经过缺口那么多步就回到那个点，并且一直停在那里。
passages.statement: Balanced, within the gap and opposing at every step from T: the gap falls by at least one a step, and the level is m at every step from T plus the gap at T.

passages.en: A ring that closes a departure brings the turn with the departure and the turn without it to one, and later turns go on as one: closing forgets, and a turn that forgets nothing closes nothing.
passages.zh: 环把一个偏离合上，就把有偏离的和没偏离的带到同一处，此后一直合为一个：合上就是忘掉；什么都不忘的，什么也合不上。
passages.statement: Where f 0 = 0 and the course from a positive d reaches 0, f takes two distinct differences to one (Law.Merges), so f is not lossless.

passages.en: With the same links at every step, how far two courses can be driven apart at a place stays under some fixed power of the steps exactly where no ring lies upstream of it.
passages.zh: 环节每一步都一样时，两条进程在某处能被拉开多远，恰在它上游没有环的时候，不超过步数的某个固定次方。
passages.statement: Stationary strengths, conditions listed once: the gap at c is bounded by A·(t+1)^n for every law within the strengths and every bound on starting gaps iff no condition upstream of c is on a loop.

passages.en: A link that weakens with what it has carried stops acting for good exactly where its response falls to nothing at some amount; one whose response never reaches nothing keeps acting, and more passes through it every step.
passages.zh: 一个环节传得越多就越弱：恰在传到某个量时回应降到零，它就从此不再起作用；回应永远降不到零的，一直起作用，每一步都有更多经过它。
passages.statement: Strength f(passed) times k with f not rising, acting and standing at every step: the coupling stops by some step iff f A = 0 for some A; with f ≥ 1 everywhere it recurs and at least t has passed by t.

passages.en: Among finitely many states under one fixed law, every course is, before as many steps as there are states, at a state it comes back to, staying put included: growing on itself without end needs room without end.
passages.zh: 状态只有有限几种、律又固定时，每条进程在步数达到状态数之前，就已处在一个会再回来的状态上，停着不动也算：要无止境地越滚越大，得有无止境的余地。
passages.statement: With every configuration in a list of length m, for every start there is n < m with the orbit at step n a returning configuration.

passages.en: Among finitely many states, some course keeps changing exactly where a change within reach can be undone; where no change in reach can be undone, no course keeps changing.
passages.zh: 状态有限时，恰在够得着的某个变化可以撤回的地方，有一条进程一直变下去；够得着的变化都撤不回，就没有哪条进程一直变。
passages.statement: In a world a list holds: some run from s changes at arbitrarily late steps iff some x reachable from s steps to y ≠ x from which x is reachable.

passages.en: From one state a course can step at once into a place it never leaves, while another course from the same state keeps coming back: that it can be lost does not mean it is.
passages.zh: 从同一个状态出发，一条进程可以一步走进再也出不来的地方，另一条却一直回到这里：会失去，不等于失去了。
passages.statement: In OneWay, false is possibly drawn into {true}, which is never left, but not necessarily, and false returns.

passages.en: A search that moves only to what scores higher, on a score with a top, is at rest from every start one step past the top: it stops because nothing it reaches scores higher, not because its mark is met.
passages.zh: 一个只往得分更高处走的搜索，分数有上限时，从任何起点出发，过了上限再一步就停下：停下是因为够得着的都不更高，不是因为达到了它要的。
passages.statement: Improving reward next and reward ≤ B: next leaves the orbit's state at step B + 1 unchanged, from every start.

passages.en: In a built case where the rest takes faster than renewal, a search that tries no neighbour stays at holding back, which the score settles on at no weight; one that tries every candidate leaves it for taking at its first step.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：其余的取得比补得快。一个不试任何邻近做法的搜索停在克制上，而分数在任何权重下都不落在那里；什么都试的搜索，第一步就离开克制，转向多取。
passages.statement: With empty neighbourhoods the identity is a local search resting at restraint, though restraint settles at no weight; every local search with every candidate a neighbour moves restraint to the drawing law.

passages.en: Where each gives more the more is left of each, and a step keeps every level within a band, every course from within the band is still within a bounded number of steps.
passages.zh: 每一方给得多少都随各方剩下的多少而涨，一步又不把任何水平带出一个范围，那么从这个范围里出发的每条进程，在有限的步数内都停下不变。
passages.statement: Giving rising with what is left of each and a band up to hi: for a pair the run is still from some step at most 2hi + 1; for a listed web from some step at most count·hi + 1.

passages.en: In a built pair, each giving only where enough of the other is left, either alone ends from every level; together, from two and three, neither ends, and they pass between two-three and three-two for ever.
passages.zh: 一个构造的两方例子：各自只在对方剩得够时才给。单独哪一方，从任何水平出发都会尽；合在一起，从二和三出发，两方都不尽，在二、三与三、二之间一直来回。
passages.statement: Giving rises, each alone ends from every level, yet the run from (2,3) stays within three, neither ends, and is never still.

passages.en: Where members are replaced one at a time by chance, even a kind the replacing favours can be lost, leaving all on the other: from a count of i, the courses losing it weigh at least a fixed share to the power i.
passages.zh: 成员一次换一个、凭机会换时，就算是替换偏向的那一种，也可能失去，剩下的全是另一种：从 i 个起，失去它的那些进程，分量至少是某个固定份额的 i 次方。
passages.statement: From i mixed or none, the histories losing the first kind weigh at least b^i times every later history, b^i·(a+b)^k.

passages.en: From a disagreement that looks the same with the members swapped and the forms swapped, a law that favours neither member nor form never brings them to agree: coming to one needs something that breaks the tie.
passages.zh: 一种分歧，把成员对调、把说法对调都还是原样，那么一个既不偏哪个成员、也不偏哪种说法的律，永远不让它们一致：要归到同一个上，得有打破平局的东西。
passages.statement: A law keeping an exchange of formations and a renaming that moves every form never brings formations it exchanges, from a symmetric start, to agree at that sense at any step.

passages.en: Two things stop being told apart where one code is put in place of every member's: each loses exactly the differences its own code made that the imposed one does not. A law keeping a symmetry never merges what it moves apart.
passages.zh: 把一套编码放到每个成员原来编码的位置上，两样东西就分不出来了：各自失去的，恰是自己原先分开、而这套编码不分的那些差别。保持一种对称的律，从不把这种对称换开的两者并成一个。
passages.statement: The imposed code (every code replaced, not a hearing) makes all agree; a formation loses m from m' iff its code told them apart and the imposed code gives them one form; where two runs exchanged by a fixed-point-free map meet, the law does not commute with it.

passages.en: Once every member gives a thing the same form, the form there never changes again on any course, under any rule of taking what is heard: all on one is a rest.
passages.zh: 一旦每个成员对一样东西用的都是同一个说法，这里的说法在哪条进程上都不再变，不管照什么规则采纳听到的：都用同一个，就是停下了。
passages.statement: If every formation gives m one form at step n, every formation's form at m is the same at n + k for every k, on every run, under every rule.

stays.en: Where everything inside and outside holds the imposed form, every member holds it at every later step under any rule, so the merge lasts until another form comes from outside or is newly made.
stays.zh: 里面外面都用强加的那个说法时，在任何规则下，每个成员此后每一步都还用它；这个合并一直在，直到别的说法从外面来，或者新造出来。

stays.en: Agreement lasts through every hearing among those that agree, and it stays with all exactly while no holder leaves a successor that does not hold it.
stays.zh: 只在一致的成员之间互相听，一致就一直保持；它留在所有成员身上，恰好是在没有哪个持有者留下不持有它的后继的时候。

stays.en: Under a law that favours neither member nor form, a disagreement unchanged by swapping stays at every step; and a share that selection raised can fall back at the next draw by chance, rarely in large draws, never ruled out.
stays.zh: 律既不偏哪个成员、也不偏哪种说法时，对调也不变的分歧每一步都还在；选择抬高的份额，下一次抽取也可能凭机会落回去，样本大时少见，但从不排除。

stays.en: A link that reads a stock only below some level acts, while the stock is above it, as its standing law does, which carries no ring through the stock.
stays.zh: 一个只在存量低于某个水平时才看它的环节，存量在那之上时，就跟它平常的律一样作用，而那条律不经过这个存量形成环。

stays.en: While a ring is fed and its links keep acting, every account that follows chains of effects only up to some length misses something downstream of it at some step.
stays.zh: 只要环有东西进来、环节一直起作用，任何只把因果链算到某个长度的说法，都会在某一步漏掉它下游的一些东西。

stays.en: A correction read late keeps a level only within a band at least twice one more than its lateness times the most a step can move the level; a late answer attains that width.
stays.zh: 一个晚几步才读到的纠正，能把水平守住的范围，至少是“晚的步数加一”乘以一步最多挪动的量，再乘二；晚一点的回推正好能做到这个宽度。

stays.en: It goes on growing while every link round the ring passes on at least twice what it gets: after n turns the difference is at least two to the n times where it started.
stays.zh: 只要环上每个环节传出去的都至少是收到的两倍，它就一直长：转 n 圈之后，差别至少是起点的 2 的 n 次方倍。

stays.en: No state at rest meets a mark of more than now; where what stands runs down at every step from some point, the rises stop coming, from running out, not from having enough.
stays.zh: 停着的状态都达不到“比现在多”的标准；要是从某一刻起，存着的东西每一步都在减少，上涨就不再来了：是用完了，不是够了。

stays.en: Once a course is at a state its law leaves as it is, it stays there at every later step: under one fixed law nothing inside moves it on.
stays.zh: 进程一旦到了它的律不再改变的状态，此后每一步都停在那里：律固定时，里面没有什么能再推动它。

stays.en: Taking only steps after which it can still be had keeps it within reach; at a fork the step that keeps it is taken only if the loss reached what chooses before; a whole given a unit by the rest each step never comes round.
stays.zh: 只走那些走了之后还能回来的步，就一直够得着它；到了岔口，只有失去的消息先传到做选择的那一方，才会走留住它的那一步；其余每一步都给进一份的整体，永远不会转回来。

stays.en: A push past the gap at every step crosses the mark for ever and is never on it; for a late relay each upward crossing is followed by a downward one, and that by an upward one.
stays.zh: 每一步的推回都超过缺口，就永远来回越过那个点，从不落在点上；读得晚的开关，每次往上越过之后必有一次往下越过，再接着往上。

conditions.says_en: Two things once kept apart are now treated as one by everything inside. Nothing held inside can bring the difference back.
conditions.says_zh: 原先分开的两样东西，现在里面全都当成一样。里面留着的任何东西都找不回这个差别。
conditions.why: True to outside_needed: forms held anywhere keep the merge; coining (coined_returns) is a new form, not one held, so 'held' is exact.

conditions.says_en: Every member holds the same one, so copying only repeats it. Another returns only from outside the group or by being newly made.
conditions.says_zh: 每个成员用的都是同一个，互相学只是重复它。别的做法只能从外面来，或者新造出来。
conditions.why: agreement_kept, held_stays and run_kept_iff give exactly this.

conditions.says_en: More than one way is in use, or none yet, and not all have come to one.
conditions.says_zh: 不止一种做法在用，或者还没有哪一种，还没有都归到同一个上。
conditions.why: The negation of AgreeAt, as already fixed; kept in its fixed wording.

conditions.says_en: What it does is passed on down the line and no chain of effects leads back to it.
conditions.says_zh: 它做的只往下游传，没有哪条因果的链子绕回它自己。
conditions.why: Not OnLoop. Note that the line law speaks of no ring upstream of a place, which is wider than the place itself being on no ring; the gloss reads the narrower one.

conditions.says_en: A chain of effects leads back to where it started, so a difference can go round.
conditions.says_zh: 有一条因果的链子绕回起点，于是一点差别可以转着圈走。
conditions.why: OnLoop, formed in time by couplings acting at steps; 'can go round' is right, since what a turn does with a difference is left to the links (LoopReturn).

conditions.says_en: From some step on, every push is against the departure and no larger than the gap. The gap then closes within as many steps as it is wide, and stays closed.
conditions.says_zh: 从某一步起，每一次推回都朝偏离的反方向，又不超过缺口。缺口至多经过它那么宽的步数就合上，并且一直合着。
conditions.why: Flow.settles needs the push opposing and within the gap at every step from T, and gives the step bound; 'a departure is answered' read as a single answer, which the law does not cover.

conditions.says_en: What goes round comes back larger than it left, so each round starts from more.
conditions.says_zh: 转一圈回来的比出去的多，所以每一圈都从更多开始。
conditions.why: It had no anchors. The laws that conclude unbounded growth assume each link at least doubles, or a whole-number product of at least two; the gloss describes the condition and does not claim a rate.

conditions.says_en: Nothing it could stay at meets what it is after: the mark is set against where it now is, or two or more are each after standing above all the rest.
conditions.says_zh: 它停在哪里都达不到它要的：那个标准是对着它现在的位置定的；或者两个以上各自都要压过其余所有的。
conditions.why: Already fixed; true. Training.comes_to_rest shows that such a course can still come to rest, with its mark unmet, so the gloss rightly says 'meets' and not 'stops'.

conditions.says_en: From some point on nothing about it changes: nothing arises or ceases, no level rises or falls. It may rest at some level, or at nothing; an end is one way of resting.
conditions.says_zh: 从某一刻起，它什么都不再变：没有新生的，没有消失的，存量不涨不落。可以停在某个水平上，也可以停在零上；“尽了”是停下的一种。
conditions.why: Already fixed; true.

conditions.says_en: It comes back where it was, again and again; staying put counts as coming back. It keeps changing on the way exactly where a change within reach can be undone; built cases that lose nothing never stop.
conditions.says_zh: 它一次次回到原来的地方，停着不动也算回来。恰在够得着的变化可以撤回的地方，它一路一直在变；有几个构造的例子什么都不损耗，就永远停不下来。
conditions.why: Returns includes a step to itself, so 'keeps changing' is more than the anchor says. 'Where nothing is lost, nothing stops it' is shown only in built cases (Passing, Recycle, Net.cycle_never_rests); no general law says a lossless course never rests.

conditions.says_en: Each correction goes too far or comes too late, so the mark is passed from both sides again and again.
conditions.says_zh: 每次纠正不是过了头，就是来得太晚，于是一次次从两边越过那个点。
conditions.why: True: crosses_of_above for one crossing, Overshooting and held_oscillates for crossing without end, upCrossing_next for the alternation.

not_there: e2.grow to e2.rest or e2.good: no law shows growing on itself ending. A link that wears out stops (Saturation), but no theorem joins that to the growth round the ring.
e2.swing to e2.good from inside the course: no law shows an overshooting or late correction coming within the gap unless the rule or the values read are changed.
e2.rest to e2.round or e2.grow: nothing shows a course at rest starting again from inside; change resumes only with exchange from beyond (the settled need toward a1.up).
d3.one to d3.merged by hearing alone: only an imposed code is shown to merge two things; no law has copying lose a distinction.
d3.several to d3.one by copying errors: past the error threshold the carriers' share falls at every step (Reproduction.Mutation), but reaching none is not shown.
Ways from the e2 conditions back to e1: no law says that growing, swinging or coming round makes or opens a ring; the e1 passages rest on when links act.
written.notes:

Two passages join different readings, so the coordinator should look at them:

(2) e1.ring -> e2.round. This reads 'a difference comes back whole every turn' as coming round. In the return map's own course that difference is constant, so a stricter reading would place it at e2.rest.

passages.en: A difference going round falls only through a link passing on less than it got. Where every turn returns less than it is sent, and nothing for nothing, it is gone for good within as many turns as its size.
passages.zh: 绕着环走的差别，只有经过一个传出去比收到少的环节才会变小。每转一圈还回来的都比送进去的少、零进零出，那么差别有多大，至多转那么多圈就没了，此后一直没有。
passages.why: Laws real and right. closes_within needs f 0 = 0 and f x < x for every positive x, and gives 0 at turn d and at every later turn. The first reader's 'gives back less than any difference' can be read as 'less than every difference', which is not the premise; reworded, and 'stays gone' added since the Lean gives it. Kind law: under the premise the course itself closes. e2.good fits (gap closes and stays closed).

passages.en: Round a ring whose every link passes on at least twice what it gets, a difference passes every bound. Where links multiply by whole numbers nothing lies between: the product closes it at once, keeps it, or grows it.
passages.zh: 环上每个环节传出去的都至少是收到的两倍，差别就越过任何界限。环节都按整数倍传时，没有中间的情形：乘积为零，一圈就合上；为一，原样留着；二以上，越滚越大。
passages.why: Sentence kept word for word: it matches runs_away_unbounded (a loop with a link, each link at least doubling, positive start) and whole_factors (product 0, 1, at least 2). Only the law list changes: runaway_of_roundTrip is removed, because it speaks of the most difference that can arrive under coupling strengths in time, which this sentence does not say; it is given its own passage under 'missing'.

passages.en: Round a ring whose turn returns no less for a larger difference than a smaller and does not raise the starting one, the difference never rises and, within as many turns as its size, settles where a turn leaves it unchanged.
passages.zh: 环转一圈，大的差别还回来的不比小的少，又不抬高起点的差别，那么差别永不上升，至多转它大小那么多圈，就停在转一圈也不变的地方。
passages.why: Laws right; quantifiers and bound right. 'Keeps a larger difference no smaller' could be read as f x ≥ x; the premise is order kept (x ≤ y gives f x ≤ f y), so reworded. The rest is at the grain of turns: the settled value may be nothing (closed) or a positive difference that then comes back whole each turn.

passages.en: Round a ring each of whose links passes on exactly what it gets, a difference comes back whole at every turn: no turn closes it and none grows it.
passages.zh: 环上每个环节收多少就传多少，差别每转一圈都原样回来：哪一圈都不合上，也不变大。
passages.why: Says exactly loop_kept. Placed at e2.round by the row's own question (what comes back each turn: the same). Counted turn by turn the difference is constant, which is rest at that grain; link by link it is passed round and arrives back. Both descriptions are of one course at two step sizes; the sentence claims only what the Lean does.

passages.en: Once every push is against the departure and no larger than the gap, at every step, the level is at its mark within as many steps as the gap was wide, and stays there.
passages.zh: 只要从某一步起，每一次推回都朝偏离的反方向、又不超过缺口，水平至多经过缺口那么多步就回到那个点，并且一直停在那里。
passages.why: Matches Flow.settles: within the gap and opposing at every step from T, the level is m from T plus the gap at T on. The balance premise (the level changes by what is given less what is taken) is the model's bookkeeping and may stay unsaid. What rests is the level; giving and taking may go on, equal.

passages.en: A ring giving nothing for nothing closes a difference only by taking two differences to one, which then go on as one: where every difference comes round, no two are taken to one and none is closed.
passages.zh: 零进零出的环要合上一个差别，只能把两个不同的差别带到同一个上，此后它们一直是同一个：每个差别都转得回来的地方，没有两个被并成一个，也就没有哪个被合上。
passages.why: The laws are real, but the merge they prove is of two differences (states of one course) under the return map, not of two things in the forms members hold, which is what row d3 asks and what d3.merged is anchored on. Within row e2 the same laws say what separates closing from coming round: closing needs a merge, and where every difference returns nothing merges (lossless_of_returns). So it stands as a necessary condition from e2.round to e2.good. The first reader also dropped the premise f 0 = 0: without it a turn swapping 0 and 1 forgets nothing and still takes 1 to 0.

passages.en: With the same links at every step, among finitely many places, how far two courses can be driven apart at a place stays under some fixed power of the steps exactly where no ring lies upstream of it.
passages.zh: 地方有限、环节每一步都一样时，两条进程在某处能被拉开多远，恰在它上游没有环的时候，不超过步数的某个固定次方。
passages.why: Exact iff, direction and quantifiers right ('can be driven apart' carries 'every law within the strengths, every bound on starting gaps'). Added the premise that every place is listed once (finitely many). The line is 'no ring upstream of the place', wider than 'the place is on no ring'; the sentence says upstream.

passages.en: A link fed at every step from a standing level, weakening with what it has carried, stops for good exactly where its response reaches nothing at some amount; otherwise it keeps acting, and more passes every step.
passages.zh: 一个环节每一步都从一个一直有存量的地方取读数，传过去的越多，回应只减不增：恰在传到某个量时回应降到零，它就从此不再起作用；否则它一直起作用，每一步都有更多经过它。
passages.why: stops_iff needs the underlying link to act at every step and the level it reads to stand at every step; without them a link can fall silent though its response never reaches nothing, so both are now said. The theorem is about one link; that the link is one of a ring's is the placement. It supplies what the settled e1.ring → e1.line 'needs' left open (when a link stops). For a place coupled into itself the ring side is stated directly by Saturation.floored_inexact and Saturation.exact.

passages.en: Among finitely many states under one fixed law, every course is, before as many steps as there are states, at a state it comes back to, staying put included: growing on itself without end needs room without end.
passages.zh: 状态只有有限几种、律又固定时，每条进程在步数达到状态数之前，就已处在一个会再回来的状态上，停着不动也算：要无止境地越滚越大，得有无止境的余地。
passages.why: Matches the statement (every start, some step below the count, a returning configuration; returning includes a step to itself). The clause after the colon follows from the premise alone. The theorem holds from any start; e2.grow as the 'from' is a choice of where it bites, and the destination is 'coming round or at rest', which the sentence says.

passages.en: Among finitely many states, some course keeps changing exactly where a change within reach can be undone; where no change in reach can be undone, no course keeps changing.
passages.zh: 状态有限时，恰在够得着的某个变化可以撤回的地方，有一条进程一直变下去；够得着的变化都撤不回，就没有哪条进程一直变。
passages.why: Exact, with 'some course' kept and the far side said as 'no course keeps changing', not as rest at a named step (which needs more than the core gives).

passages.en: In a built case, from one state one course steps at once into a place it never leaves, while another stays at that state for ever: that it can be lost does not mean it is.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：从同一个状态出发，一条进程一步走进再也出不来的地方，另一条一直停在这个状态上：会失去，不等于失去了。
passages.why: Law right. In the witness the state returns by staying where it is (the run that keeps false), so 'keeps coming back' is said as 'stays'; and the sentence now says it is a built case, as the other built passages do.

passages.en: A search that only stays or moves to what scores higher, on a score with a ceiling, is at rest from every start within one step more than that ceiling; at rest, a mark of more than now is unmet.
passages.zh: 一个只会停着不动、或者走到得分更高处的搜索，分数有上限时，从任何起点出发，至多比上限多一步就停下；停下的地方，达不到“比现在多”的标准。
passages.why: comes_to_rest: improving (stay, or move to a strictly higher score) and score at most B give rest at step B + 1 from every start. 'It stops because nothing it reaches scores higher' is more than the premise: an improving search may stay though something higher exists. The unmet mark is Law.more_never_rests, now cited. Reading the search as after 'more than now' is the placement at e2.norest.

passages.en: In a built case where the rest takes faster than renewal, a search trying no neighbour stays at holding back, which the score settles on at no weight; one trying every candidate leaves it for taking at once.
passages.zh: 一个构造的例子：其余的取得比补得快。一个不试任何邻近做法的搜索停在克制上，而分数在任何权重下都不落在那里；什么都试的搜索，第一步就离开克制，转向多取。
passages.why: True to the witness at every weight. Shortened only to come within 40 words (the first reader's had 42). c1.road for 'tries no neighbour' is a reading.

passages.en: Where each gives no less the more is left of each, and a step keeps every level within a band, every course from within the band is still within a bounded number of steps.
passages.zh: 各方剩得越多，每一方给的都不会更少，一步又不把任何水平带出一个范围，那么从这个范围里出发的每条进程，在一个算得出上限的步数之内就停下不变。
passages.why: The premise is giving that does not fall as more is left of each (weakly rising), not giving that rises; 'gives more' changed to 'gives no less'. Bounds (2 hi + 1 for a pair, count times hi plus one for a listed web) left as 'bounded'. Whole numbers, each under a standing draw taken first. The theorem does not require that each actually depends on the others; d0.ring is its setting.

passages.en: In a built pair, each giving only where enough of the other is left, either alone ends from every level; together, from two and three, neither ends, and they pass between two-three and three-two for ever.
passages.zh: 一个构造的两方例子：各自只在对方剩得够时才给。单独哪一方，从任何水平出发都会尽；合在一起，从二和三出发，两方都不尽，在二、三与三、二之间一直来回。
passages.why: Sentence kept word for word. Relay.cycles states 'within three, neither ends, never still'; the exact passing between (2,3) and (3,2) is Relay.between, added to the laws.

passages.en: Members replaced one at a time by weighted chance: even the favoured kind can be lost, leaving only the other. From a count of i, the courses losing it weigh at least the downward step's share to the power i.
passages.zh: 成员一次换一个、凭带权的机会来换：就算是受偏向的那一种，也可能失去，只剩另一种。从 i 个起，失去它的那些进程，分量至少是“往下走一步”所占份额的 i 次方。
passages.why: lost_ge: b^i (a+b)^k out of (a+b)^(k+i). 'A fixed share' hid which share: it is the downward step's, b over a + b, and the loss is possible only where that is not nothing. No premise that the kind is favoured is used, so 'even the favoured kind' is right. Kind law as for the settled DrawnReplacement passage: some courses, with weight bounded below.

passages.en: From a disagreement left unchanged by swapping members and forms together, a law that favours neither member nor form never brings the swapped members to agree: coming to one needs something that breaks the tie.
passages.zh: 一种分歧，把成员和说法一起对调之后还是原样，那么一个既不偏哪个成员、也不偏哪种说法的律，永远不让被对调的成员一致：要归到同一个上，得有打破平局的东西。
passages.why: The start is symmetric under the two swaps taken together (with every form moved by the renaming), not under each alone; a start fixed by swapping members alone already agrees. 'Together' added, and 'them' made 'the swapped members', which is what the Lean concludes.

passages.en: Where one code is put in place of every member's, all agree at once, and each member loses exactly the differences its own code made that the imposed code does not make; the member whose code it was loses none.
passages.zh: 把一套编码放到每个成员原来编码的位置上，全体立刻一致；各自失去的，恰是自己的编码原先分开、而这套编码不分的那些差别；编码被采用的那个成员什么也不失去。
passages.why: Imposing is a replacement from outside the course of hearing, so 'needs' is right. 'Two things stop being told apart where one code is imposed' said more than the Lean: only the pairs the imposed code gives one form are merged, which 'exactly the differences ... the imposed code does not make' now carries. The clause from Law.Commutes.breaks is removed: that law is about two courses from mirror-image starts never being at one configuration, a merge of states, not of forms members hold.

passages.en: Once every member gives a thing the same form, and nothing outside gives it another, hearing never changes that form again, on any course and under any rule of taking what is heard: all on one is a rest.
passages.zh: 一旦每个成员对一样东西用的都是同一个说法，外面也没有别的说法，听来听去，这个说法就不再变，在哪条进程上、照什么规则采纳都一样：都用同一个，就是停下了。
passages.why: all_agree_rest is over every formation there is, so 'nothing outside gives it another' is added; and the change excluded is change by hearing, the model's only change. Kind changed from law to same: no course moves here, all-on-one seen from row e2 is a rest.

stays.en: Where everything, inside and outside, holds the imposed form for a thing, each holds it at every later step under any rule: no hearing brings the difference back unless another form is still held somewhere.
stays.zh: 里面外面对一样东西都用强加的那个说法时，在任何规则下，各自此后每一步都还用它：除非别处还留着另一个说法，否则怎么听也听不回这个差别。
stays.why: The two laws say: all hold it, so all hold it at every later step under hearing. 'Lasts until another form comes from outside' clashed with the premise that everything outside holds it too, and 'or is newly made' is coined_returns, a settled passage, not these laws. Restated as the contrapositive the Lean gives.

stays.en: Agreement lasts through every hearing among those that agree, and it stays with all exactly while no holder leaves a successor that does not hold it.
stays.zh: 只在一致的成员之间互相听，一致就一直保持；它留在所有成员身上，恰好是在没有哪个持有者留下不持有它的后继的时候。
stays.why: agreement_kept (hearings in which a member hears the thing only from a member) and kept_iff (held by every later member exactly where no member it holds of has a successor it does not hold of) say this.

stays.en: Under a law favouring neither member nor form, a disagreement unchanged by swapping both stays at every step; a raised share can fall back at the next draw: rare in large draws, never ruled out while both kinds remain.
stays.zh: 律既不偏哪个成员、也不偏哪种说法时，成员和说法一起对调也不变的分歧，每一步都还在；抬高了的份额，下一次抽取也可能落回去：样本大时少见，但只要两种都还在，就从不排除。
stays.why: 'Swapping both' for the joint symmetry. falls_back is only the upper bound (rare as the draw grows); 'never ruled out' is falls_back_ge, at least q^n, which is something only while the other kind is among the offspring. Law added and the condition said.

stays.en: A link that reads a stock only below some level acts, while the stock has stood at or above it, as its standing law does, which carries no ring through the stock.
stays.zh: 一个只在存量低于某个水平时才看它的环节，只要存量一直不低于这个水平，就跟它平常的律一样作用，而那条律不经过这个存量形成环。
stays.why: standing_no_loop gives only 'the standing law has no ring through the stock'. That the link acts as its standing law is standing_alike, under a history in which the stock has stood at the level at every step so far: 'at or above', and 'has stood', not 'is above'.

stays.en: While a ring is fed and its links keep acting, every account that follows chains of effects only up to some length misses something downstream of it at some step.
stays.zh: 只要环有东西进来、环节一直起作用，任何只把因果链算到某个长度的说法，都会在某一步漏掉它下游的一些东西。
stays.why: Matches: fed, links recurring, a path of recurring links to the place; for every length some step at which the truncated amount is strictly less.

stays.en: A correction that reads the level late keeps it, under every disturbance of bounded step, in no band narrower than twice one more than the steps late times that bound; a late answer attains this width.
stays.zh: 一个晚几步才读到水平的纠正，面对每一种每步挪动不超过某个量的扰动，守得住的范围不会窄于“晚的步数加一”乘以这个量、再乘二；有一种晚到的回推正好守住这个宽度。
stays.why: Numbers right (2 (ℓ + 1) d, attained by the late return). The bound is for a rule that keeps the band under every rest moving the level by at most d a step; 'under every disturbance' was missing. 'A correction read late' could be read as the correction being read; it is the correction that reads late.

stays.en: It goes on growing while every link round the ring passes on at least twice what it gets: after n turns the difference is at least two to the n times where it started.
stays.zh: 只要环上每个环节传出去的都至少是收到的两倍，它就一直长：转 n 圈之后，差别至少是起点的 2 的 n 次方倍。
stays.why: runs_away exactly; doubling_exact shows the bound attained.

stays.en: No state at rest meets a mark of more than now. Where what stands, finitely listed, runs down at every step from some point, no level goes on rising at ever later steps: from running out, not from having enough.
stays.zh: 停着的状态都达不到“比现在多”的标准。存着的东西数得过来，又从某一刻起每一步都在减少，那就没有哪个水平能越来越晚地一再上涨：是用完了，不是够了。
stays.why: more_exhausted refutes rises at arbitrarily late steps; it names no last rise, so 'the rises stop coming' is said as 'no level goes on rising at ever later steps'. The census of what stands (a finite listing) is a premise and is now said.

stays.en: Once a course is at a state its law leaves as it is, it stays there at every later step: under one fixed law nothing inside moves it on.
stays.zh: 进程一旦到了它的律不再改变的状态，此后每一步都停在那里：律固定时，里面没有什么能再推动它。
stays.why: stays_from_fixed and the second direction of rests_iff say this.

stays.en: Taking only steps after which it can still be had keeps it within reach. Where the step chosen keeps it in one course and loses it in another, what differs between them cannot have failed to reach what chooses before.
stays.zh: 只走那些走了之后还能回来的步，就一直够得着它。选出的一步在一条进程里留住它、在另一条里失去它，那么两条进程之间的差别，不可能没有在此之前传到做选择的一方。
stays.why: The first reader's sentence had 45 words. turned_at_juncture compares two courses and concludes, up to double negation, that their difference (the source) had reached the reader; 'the loss reached what chooses' named the wrong thing and dropped the double negation. The third clause is removed: counting_given_by_rest says only that the rest gives one unit each step, 'never comes round' is Web.counting_new, and both are a built case; it is given as a passage under 'missing' with the general law beside it.

stays.en: A push back past the gap at every step crosses the mark for ever and is never on it; for a late relay each upward crossing is followed by a downward one, and that by an upward one.
stays.zh: 每一步的推回都超过缺口，就永远来回越过那个点，从不落在点上；读得晚的开关，每次往上越过之后必有一次往下越过，再接着往上。
stays.why: The first clause is general, and the general laws are crosses_of_above, crosses_of_below and never_at_of_beyond (opposing and beyond the gap at each step); Overshooting.oscillates is only the witness that such a course exists. 'Back' added, since crossing needs the push to oppose the departure. 'And that by an upward one' is downCrossing_next, added. Alternation.alternates removed: the sentence does not say it, and the Lean shows a return every second step, not a mark passed; see 'missing'.

conditions.says_en: Two things once kept apart are now treated as one by everything inside. Nothing held inside can bring the difference back.
conditions.says_zh: 原先分开的两样东西，现在里面全都当成一样。里面留着的任何东西都找不回这个差别。
conditions.why: True to outside_needed and run_imposed_stays: by hearing, a form all hold stays. The 'things' are what members' forms tell apart; a law taking two states of one course to one (Law.Merges, as in LoopReturn.closing_merges or Commutes.breaks) is not this condition unless the coordinator widens it and adds those anchors.

conditions.says_en: Every member holds the same one, so copying only repeats it. Another returns only from outside the group or by being newly made.
conditions.says_zh: 每个成员用的都是同一个，互相学只是重复它。别的做法只能从外面来，或者新造出来。
conditions.why: agreement_kept, held_stays and run_kept_iff give this.

conditions.says_en: More than one way is in use, or none yet, and not all have come to one.
conditions.says_zh: 不止一种做法在用，或者还没有哪一种，还没有都归到同一个上。
conditions.why: The negation of agreement, in the wording already fixed.

conditions.says_en: What it does is passed on down the line and no chain of effects leads back to it.
conditions.says_zh: 它做的只往下游传，没有哪条因果的链子绕回它自己。
conditions.why: Not on a loop. The line law speaks of no ring upstream of a place, which is wider; its passage says 'upstream'.

conditions.says_en: A chain of effects leads back to where it started, so a difference can go round.
conditions.says_zh: 有一条因果的链子绕回起点，于是一点差别可以转着圈走。
conditions.why: OnLoop. A coupling that has once acted keeps a place on a loop in the Lean's sense; whether the ring still counts is whether its links go on acting, which the passages to e1.line say.

conditions.says_en: From some step on, every push is against the departure and no larger than the gap. The gap then closes within as many steps as it is wide, and stays closed.
conditions.says_zh: 从某一步起，每一次推回都朝偏离的反方向，又不超过缺口。缺口至多经过它那么宽的步数就合上，并且一直合着。
conditions.why: The first reader's fix is right and kept: Flow.settles needs opposing and within the gap at every step from T, not one answer. LoopReturn.closes_within is the same shape round a ring and is added as an anchor.

conditions.says_en: What goes round comes back larger than it left, so each round starts from more.
conditions.says_zh: 转一圈回来的比出去的多，所以每一圈都从更多开始。
conditions.why: Describes the condition and claims no rate. carried_doubles_roundTrip added: every return at least doubles what had reached the place.

conditions.says_en: Nothing it could stay at meets what it is after: the mark is set against where it now is, or two or more are each after standing above all the rest.
conditions.says_zh: 它停在哪里都达不到它要的：那个标准是对着它现在的位置定的；或者两个以上各自都要压过其余所有的。
conditions.why: Already fixed; true. Such a course can still come to rest with its mark unmet (Training.comes_to_rest), which 'meets' allows.

conditions.says_en: From some point on nothing about it changes: nothing arises or ceases, no level rises or falls. It may rest at some level, or at nothing; an end is one way of resting.
conditions.says_zh: 从某一刻起，它什么都不再变：没有新生的，没有消失的，存量不涨不落。可以停在某个水平上，也可以停在零上；“尽了”是停下的一种。
conditions.why: Already fixed; true.

conditions.says_en: It keeps changing and keeps arriving back where it was. Where each link on the way passes on exactly what it gets, what goes round comes back whole at every turn.
conditions.says_zh: 它一直在变，又一直回到原来的地方。路上每个环节收多少就传多少，转着走的东西每一圈都原样回来。
conditions.why: The first reader widened the gloss to count staying put, which makes it overlap e2.rest. The first sentence can stand as it was with a Lean anchor that does say 'keeps changing': Settling.ChangesInLoop (back at a state it was at, with a change between). Laws that conclude only Returns reach 'coming round or at rest', and their sentences say so. The first reader's second sentence lost a quantifier: keeps_changing_iff is about some course, and that line is the passage e2.round → e2.rest. 'Where nothing is lost, nothing stops it' is not shown only in built cases: LoopReturn.loop_kept is general, for links that pass on exactly what they get, and the second sentence now says that.

conditions.says_en: Each correction goes too far or comes too late, so the mark is passed from both sides again and again.
conditions.says_zh: 每次纠正不是过了头，就是来得太晚，于是一次次从两边越过那个点。
conditions.why: True. crosses_of_below and downCrossing_next added so both sides are anchored.

missing.en: With whole-number strengths, each return round a ring at least doubles the most difference that can arrive there; returns often enough outgrow every power of the steps, and for a ring of one link how often, not how strong, decides.
missing.zh: 环节的强度都是整数时，每绕回一次，能传到那里的最大差别至少翻一倍；绕回得够勤，就超过步数的任何次方；只有一个环节的环，决定的是它起作用有多勤，不是有多强。
missing.why: The first reader listed runaway_of_roundTrip under the LoopReturn passage without saying it. It is a different statement: about the carried amount (the most difference that can arrive) under couplings in time, where a return doubles because what had arrived is held and comes round once more. polynomial_iff makes it exact for one link; Sparse.polynomial is the built ring that returns ever more rarely and stays under a power. Runaway also needs something to have reached the ring.

missing.en: Where nothing comes from nothing, a finite whole given nothing net by the rest stays within its stock and again and again is where it was: being new at every step needs something given by the rest.
missing.zh: 无中不生有的地方，一个有限的整体，其余部分没有净给它什么，就守在原有的存量之内，一再回到曾经在的地方：要每一步都是新的，得有其余部分给进来的东西。
missing.why: This is the general law behind the clause the first reader put in e2.round's stay. counting_given_by_rest with counting_new is the built case showing the premise cannot be dropped: given one unit each step, new at every step. 'Is where it was' is a state had before, staying put included.

missing.en: In a built case a level drawn by one each step and given two when nothing is left, nothing otherwise, keeps within two yet moves between one and two at every step: a band alone does not bring rest.
missing.zh: 一个构造的例子：一个水平每步被取走一，剩下为零时给回二，否则不给；它始终不超过二，却每一步都在一和二之间来回：单有范围，停不下来。
missing.why: The first reader cited Alternation.alternates under e2.swing's stay without a word for it. The Lean shows a return to one every second step and no step still, which is coming round; no mark is passed. It bounds the rest law (rests_within: giving that does not fall as more is left, within a band, rests). The 'from' is a reading: a level whose giving is read off what is left of itself feeds back on itself, but no OnLoop is stated for it.

missing.en: A member taking a form it hears stops telling two things apart exactly where it already gives that form to another thing. In a built pair one hearing brings agreement on one thing and merges two for the hearer.
missing.zh: 一个成员采纳听到的说法时，恰在它已经用这个说法指另一样东西的地方，它就分不开这两样了。一个构造的两方例子里，听一次，在一样东西上一致了，听的一方却把两样并成了一样。
missing.why: The first reader's 'not there' list says no law has copying lose a distinction. keeps_apart_iff is that law, exact at each hearing that takes the form heard, and homonym is the built pair. It merges for the hearer only, so it is a step toward d3.merged ('by everything inside'), which the sentence says by naming the hearer.

checked.notes:
AI-written. I read the Lean statement and docstring of every law cited, and cards.json where a card exists; I ran nothing and changed no file. Of 19 passages: 4 kept, 14 fixed (3 of them in the law list only, sentence word for word), 1 moved, none dropped. Of 11 stays: 4 kept, 7 fixed. Four passages added.

What the coordinator should look at:
1. Two senses of 'merge'. The first reader used d3.merged for a law taking two states of one course to one (LoopReturn.closing_merges; Law.Commutes.breaks). Row d3 asks about the ways members hold, and d3.merged is anchored only on SharedCodes. I moved the closing passage to e2.round → e2.good as a 'needs' (closing needs a merge; where every difference returns nothing merges), where both ends are conditions of the row the laws are about. Law.Commutes.breaks is now cited nowhere in this part: it says two courses from mirror-image starts are never at one configuration under a law keeping the mirror. If d3.merged is meant to carry merges of states, it needs Law.Merges, Law.merged_stays and Law.Merges.loses as anchors, and both laws could return there.
2. e2.round's gloss. I did not take the first reader's widening ('staying put counts'), because it makes e2.round overlap e2.rest. The original first sentence has an anchor that says 'keeps changing' (Settling.ChangesInLoop). Passages resting on Returns alone (enters_returning_within) say 'staying put included' in their own sentences.
3. One course at two step sizes. A difference kept round a ring is constant turn by turn (rest) and passed on link by link (coming round). e1.ring → e2.round (loop_kept) and e1.ring → e2.rest (settles_within) are both true at their own grain; the map has no mark for this yet.
4. d3.one → e2.rest is now kind 'same'.
5. The first reader's 'not there' list: the item on hearing never losing a distinction is wrong (keeps_apart_iff, TwoFormations.homonym; added). The item that no theorem joins a worn-out link to a ring is partly wrong: Saturation.floored_inexact and Saturation.exact do, for a place coupled into itself; neither states that growth ends. The other items I found true: Flow.settles assumes the pushes are within the gap and does not show a swinging course coming within it.
6. Placements that are readings, each said in its 'why': e2.grow as the start of enters_returning_within (the theorem is from any start); e2.norest for an improving search; c1.road for a search that tries no neighbour; e1.ring for a single level giving by what is left of itself (Alternation); 'a link of a ring' for Saturation.stops_iff.
